Unlike the rituals, which require greater preparation, Brakknap only needs to chant for 5 consecutive rounds. During these, he is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} each round and must remain within 5 feet of the grave.

L3. The Cursed GraveModerate 7

@UUID[Actor.Ae2XMNrkBcWBz9d8]{Deathless Acolytes of Urgathoa (4)} @UUID[Actor.CESFabG5BoVb24yR]{Godclaw Hellcrown}

Creature: While having Brakknap break the curse is efficient, it also marks him as a target for the undead to eliminate, as they can sense that his power would spell their doom. When the PCs or Brakknap start the ritual, four deathless acolytes and a Godclaw hellcrown stealthily rise to surround them. The acolytes come out from the graves, remaining close by so their aura can prevent healing and keep the PCs occupied. The Godclaw hellcrown rises outside and tries to pick off the ritual's primary caster from behind the fence. Breaking the curse doesn't disrupt these undead; they must be destroyed even if the curse is broken.

If Brakknap falls unconscious, his soul immediately rises and continues chanting over his own unconscious body. The goblin dies if he remains at 0 Hit Points for 3 consecutive turns. This sacrifice automatically breaks the curse, as his body sprouts into a tree over the grave with the statistics of a 4th-rank protector tree. Before his soul departs, Brakknap makes sure to comfort the PCs, saying that his death was his choice and wasn't their fault, and that he's glad to give back to those who gave so much for his people. Brakknap then joins his ancestors for his eternal rest, finally at peace. In the years afterward, more trees grow in Gillamoor in the direction of Chitterwood until the two woods become one.

Scene Notes Macros

@UUID[Macro.QihVeYqMUkCtz5UY]{Start Ritual} @UUID[Macro.q1pK2IPaCo7ED7xv]{Break Curse} @UUID[Macro.yH0QABO4A0Ygng6r]{Reset}

Adds Sounds and Lights around the grave, and sprouts a tree when the curse is broken

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.C6DoQYAMJFdSBCWu]{Grave}
The PCs find a grim trophy, 20 gp, 100 gp worth of loose gemstones, and a restful salve.

Development: If the PCs Search the grave, they uncover Dottol's diary, which details his survey near Finder's Gulch. In it, he notes the gulch is rumored to be the hideout of the Wight Mother of Isger. Dottol recorded feeling sickly after his survey, but his last entry takes place months later. In it, he complains of dysentery but rejoices to be heading for Gillamoor.

The PCs need to spend only an hour studying the diary to deduce that Finder's Gulch is where they should head next and that Illcayna is the enemy behind the undead. Anyone local to Isger automatically knows the legendary Wight Mother of Isger is a Child of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22214plotso.JournalEntryPage.14plotsofthepa00]{Urgathoa} said to be destined to conquer Isger with an army of wights. Non-locals, however, must succeed at a @Check[religion|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[isger-lore|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to recall this information.

Reward: The PCs gain 30 XP and 5 Reputation Points if they lift the curse in Gillamoor in addition to the usual XP from combat. If Brakknap is the one who breaks the curse and survives the process, the PCs gain an additional 10 XP. The oracle grows more powerful, and the GM can apply the elite template to Brakknap's statistics.

Keeper's Hut.name: Keeper's Hut
Keeper's Hut.text:
L2. Keeper's Hut

The grave keeper's home was one of the last buildings to be left behind. The windows and doors are well-fortified. The interior is covered in a layer of dust but is otherwise suitable for an overnight rest… if the curse is no longer in effect.

Dying Erinyes: If the PCs spared Sister Endreah, the leader of the Golden Erinys from @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22202forthe]{Chapter 2}, they find her here with 1 Hit Point left, succumbing to the curse. If Endreah died, the PCs find Sister Sylve instead.

The Erinys sisters are not here for the curse; they were led here to hunt whoever disturbed the graves of their deceased. In truth, the missing dead have risen as wights loyal to Illcayna. The newly undead lured their past compatriots to Gillamoor in hopes of killing them to fuel the curse here.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.ZaAATo8pO19DUaPw]{Sister Endreas' Gift} @UUID[Actor.Jbrmo3qjrF73kTev]{Grave}
If the PCs manage to lift the curse before the 10th of Calistril, the sister here survives and takes shelter in Saringallow. She gifts the PCs the token of salt and earth that saved her and points them to a disturbed grave where she saw a calamity sticking out.

The Order of the Pike.name: The Order of the Pike
The Order of the Pike.text:
L1. The Order of the PikeTrivial 7

The Hellbreakers aren't the only ones seeking the curse's source. A Hellknight contingent from the Order of the Pike, which is dedicated to slaying monsters that threaten society, broke off from Caeto's forces after he ordered them to ignore the undead. They then located Gillamoor and came to see if they could solve the problem.

L1. The Order of the PikeTrivial 7

@UUID[Actor.AGyKF5KOcPsHByhh]{Hecatinia} @UUID[Actor.mlUs8sLzvolxCW93]{Hestlebeth} @UUID[Actor.4GCgXZEmlWG8FXZi]{Skeletal Giants (2)}

Creatures: Unfortunately, the undead thinned the Hellknights' ranks as they traveled. Only Hecatinia and Hestlebeth Remsaine (determined female human Hellknight twins 3), nieces to the lictor of the Order of the Pike, managed to reach Gillamoor. When the PCs arrive, the twins are about to be overwhelmed by skeletal giants.

Recruiting Hellknights: If the PCs save Hecatinia and Hestlebeth, the party can use @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq.JournalEntryPage.07howtorecruit00#recruit-for-the-cause]{Recruit for the Cause} to attempt to recruit the Order of the Pike. Friendly gestures such as healing the twins and providing shelter for them decreases the DC of the check by 2. On a success, the twins convince their aunt to send an impressive @UUID[Actor.kQJn4brkv7PGDfwm]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigade} to the Hellbreakers (two cavalries on a critical success).

Reward: If the PCs manage to recruit the Order of the Pike to their cause, they gain 2 Reputation Points. If they intentionally killed the exhausted armigers, the Hellbreakers lose 5 Reputation Points over the controversy. The sisters have a scroll with the ritual @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xKHq2Eisapixvj6q]{Divine Keystone} as well as the components necessary to cast it, having planned to use it to create a safe haven for themselves within the cursed village.

The Curse of Gillamoor.name: The Curse of Gillamoor
The Curse of Gillamoor.text:
L. The Curse of Gillamoor

After the Goblinblood Wars ended, Illcayna placed a curse she was testing on a merchant who was scouting out new trade routes. The unfortunate merchant later passed from sickness and was buried in Gillamoor. The curse on his body desecrated the settlement, and both the bodies previously buried in its graveyard and its living villagers transformed into undead. For a while, this curse was misidentified as a plague. The town was quarantined, and the steward put up a bounty for a cure. When none could find the nonexistent disease, however, the bounty was rescinded and Gillamoor forgotten… until now.

The curse is but a trial run of the ritual Illcayna wishes to inflict on Isger. With the true ritual underway, Gillamoor has become a conduit—one of many helping the ritual take root in the nation's very soil. While dispelling the curse here does not stop Illcayna's ritual, it can reduce the rate at which the undead spawn.

Village Condition: In the wake of the Goblinblood Wars but before the curse took hold, Gillamoor quickly recovered, becoming a vibrant village in the post-war economic boom. It was popular with caravans under Druma's Mercenary League, who preferred homely bed-and-breakfasts to the crowded inns of larger settlements. Once the curse took root, the inhabitants left the village for the undead and weather to ravage. Today, Gillamoor is a decrepit ruin full of collapsed huts and houses. It's devoid of the nature that usually reclaims such sites, and any trees still standing have an unhealthy wilt to them, their leaves spotted yellow and black. In the unsettling silence, the way to the graveyard is clear.

Negotiating with Goblins.name: Negotiating with Goblins
Negotiating with Goblins.text:
Negotiating with Goblins

Recruiting Thorngrip is a more delicate matter given the lingering sentiments from the Goblinblood Wars. The new Hellbreakers army makes many goblinoids wary that it might become a threat to them in the future. While the PCs don't meet any resistance when they arrive in Thorngrip, the atmosphere is tense and their reception cold. Brakknap is the only one who greets the PCs warmly.

“You come in difficult times to make a difficult request. The voices of my ancestors say this took place quite often over fifty-ten generations ago. I wonder why it stopped. Death has come for us all; prematurely, in many cases. I, for one, do not want to see the Chitterwood lifeless, so let us speak openly of the peace we both desire beyond all this death.”

After the PCs and Brakknap have caught up, they can begin negotiations with Thorngrip. This is an Influence challenge (GM Core 187) against the council of elders. The PCs have six 10-minute rounds to make their discovery and influence checks.

Scene Notes Point Tracking

@UUID[Actor.gyhPJSC7a5zm7HSd]{Council of Elders Influence}

Council of Elders

  • Goblin
  • Humanoid

Cautious goblin leadership

Perception +19

Will +17

Discovery @Check[chitterwood-lore|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], @Check[goblin-lore|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge], or @Check[isger-lore|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] (Recall Knowledge), @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] (Recall Knowledge), @Check[diplomacy|dc:26|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] (Gather Information)

Influence Skills @Check[chitterwood-lore|dc:26] or @Check[goblin-lore|dc:26] or @Check[isger-lore|dc:26], @Check[diplomacy|dc:27], @Check[deception|dc:29] or @Check[intimidation|dc:29]

Influence 2 The PCs agree to these four terms in exchange for two @UUID[Actor.EI12KtMe3f0KGsLE]{Goblin Rabbles}:

  • Chitterwood gets to rule itself autonomously.
  • The Isgeri government must form a reconciliation committee with Chitterwood.
  • Isger must establish a holiday of reconciliation that involves the exchange of Bounty's Light.
  • Isger must help the goblins restore parts of the wood burned down during the war.

Influence 4 The PCs agree to Chitterwood's autonomy and two other terms in exchange for two goblin rabbles. The PCs gain 2 Reputation Points.

Influence 6 The council agrees to Chitterwood's autonomy and one other term. In addition to the rabbles, the PCs recruit one @UUID[Actor.VDGdU79R7nyLxVq8]{Hobgoblin Battalion}. The PCs gain 2 Reputation Points.

Influence 8 The council only insists on Chitterwood's autonomy. The PCs recruit troops as per Influence 6 and gain 5 Reputation Points instead of 2.

Resistances While the elders understand human memories are longer and slower to forgive, they believe the goblins and humans should continue interacting on a daily basis. Any influence attempts that suggest the goblinoids and humans should keep to themselves increase the DC of the roll by 2.

Weaknesses The elders love rhymes. One PC can attempt a @Check[performance|dc:26] or @Check[theater-lore|dc:26] check at the start of each round to compose offers in limerick. On a success, all Influence DCs decrease by 2 for that round.

Background Council members have fancy or simple titles like “Master of the Communal Mud” or “Two.”

Appearance Six goblinoids make up this leadership council. All are considered elders, though this might be due to experience rather than age in some cases.

Personality The council is chaotic yet cohesive, each doing their best for this part of the Chitterwood.

Penalty The elders mistrust the written word. If the PCs mention or engage in the practice of writing, all influence DCs increase by 2 until the PCs and Brakknap forgo a round to assure the council that the party won't bind their souls through text. Making this cultural error a second time increases the DCs permanently.

Development: After negotiations, Brakknap asks to join the party. He says he wishes to aid the PCs, particularly in locating the curse. The elders insist their advisor take two bodyguards with him (a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.sA2dFdRUwiapo69Z]{Goblin Commando} and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Ky5eNRvN71O0tY9l]{Goblin Pyro}). While these goblins can't participate meaningfully in combat, they do help drag Brakknap out of combat if a fight starts.

In truth, Brakknap has learned of a way to break the undead curse from his ancestors, but they cautioned that it might come at the cost of his life. The goblin oracle faces his end bravely for the greater good. He keeps this to himself, thinking the PCs and elders would reject his aid or prevent him from leaving if they knew of his impending death.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.vFPTnsXFh4j0SWde]{Council's Gift}
In celebration of reaching an accord, the council of elders gifts Bounty's Light to the PCs.

Reward: Regardless of how well they negotiated, the PCs gain 80 XP.

How to Discover a Source.name: How to Discover a Source
How to Discover a Source.text:
How to Discover a Source

Some PCs might be more comfortable with academic pursuits, such as determining the location of the curse, than they are with attempting recruitment. This mission is conducted through the Locate the Curse downtime activity. To discover that Gillamoor is the curse's source, the party needs to obtain 10 Tracking Points with the Victory Point system (GM Core 184).

Locate the Curse

  • concentrate
  • Downtime

You spend the day pursuing rumors or tracing undead movements as you travel to triangulate the source of the undead scourge. You can take this activity once per day. Attempt a @Check[arcana|dc:25], @Check[diplomacy|dc:25], @Check[occultism|dc:25], @Check[religion|dc:25], @Check[survival|dc:25], or suitable Lore check to Gather Information. GMs can allow other skills as they see fit and award circumstance bonuses for appropriate supporting actions or activities. If Brakknap is with the party, all DCs in this activity decrease by 5.

If the PCs don't reach 10 Tracking Points by the 7th of Calistril, Maire beats them to the punch. Alceo shares the news with everyone that night through @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]{Dream Message}. As he and Phoebe can't step away from Logas for a day or two yet, those closest to Gillamoor—likely the party—should investigate the place.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.oqnd1dOTYNSi5IGT]{Rhokrag's Reward} @UUID[Actor.uya7hy0ji3eKuSpg]{Rhokrag's Consulation Reward}
Rhokrag put a lot of gold on the line to motivate the party. Should the PCs discover the location first, they can pick up their reward of 100 gp each when they next return to Saringallow. If they lose and pay up, Rhokrag gives them two jars of warding paste and a restful salve each as consolation.

Reward: The PCs receive 30 XP if they locate the curse before Maire.

How to Recruit an Army.name: How to Recruit an Army
How to Recruit an Army.text:
How to Recruit an Army

From here on, the PCs can use the Assist a Settlement downtime activity and Recruit for the Cause exploration activity to recruit troop units to use in skirmish encounters. For @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq]{Chapter 7}, access to different troops gives PCs options in an upcoming skirmish encounter. In @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat]{Chapter 9}, the number of troops the PCs have recruited matters slightly more. The PCs can continue using these activities during and after this chapter, either to make up for a failed recruitment or to obtain the stronger advance troop. When running these activities, GMs can reintroduce past NPCs to provide roleplay opportunities.

Settlement Units: The troops recruitable from each settlement are as listed in the Settlement Units table above. The PCs should keep track of what and how many units they have recruited.

  • Swiftrun's Erastilian clergy are difficult to persuade, while the apprentice mages are eager to prove themselves.
  • The nature of Stumpfield's art makes some residents natural saboteurs.
  • Stumpfield's local spoken word association easily picks up warchanting.
  • Umok can request that the wolves among their animal defenders aid the Hellbreakers.
  • The gnome beastspeakers who communicate with the animals join if Umok is secured.
  • While Vordia doesn't have enough people to offer troops, they do know a few mercenaries they can hire instead.
  • There are bandits hiding around Wolfpoint who can be persuaded—or intimidated—to join.

Treasure: Succeeding at the Assist a Settlement activity during Chapter 7 also rewards the PCs with items, as listed in the Settlement Skills and Rewards table above. Succeeding at Assist a Settlement outside of Chapter 7 does not yield these treasures, though GMs can give the items out for other accomplishments later at their discretion.

Reward: If the PCs successfully recruit troops from three different settlements, they gain 2 Reputation Points and 30 XP. If they manage to recruit troops from all five settlements, they instead gain 5 Reputation Points and 50 XP. This reward can be earned at any point, even outside of this chapter.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.d2fUJQ1dXqZqNV0Q]{Town} @UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.dIUYMyErQiQrvb69]{Isger Countryside}

Assist a Settlement

  • concentrate
  • Downtime

You spend a day helping a settlement prepare for incursions or defend against dangers. This is a @Check[crafting|dc:25], @Check[society|dc:25], or @Check[survival|dc:25] check to fortify the location, or a @Check[religion|dc:25], @Check[scouting-lore|dc:25], or @Check[stealth|dc:25] check to guard those leaving. The DC for these checks is a hard DC based on your current level (DC 25 for level 7). The GM can accept other skills as they see fit.

As part of this activity, the party can travel up to their Speed or the Speed of their mount or vehicle per day. Each settlement has additional skills you can use that are listed on the Settlement Skills and Rewards table above. The DC for these skills is an easy DC for your current level (DC 21 for level 7). You can only Assist a Settlement once per month.

Critical Success As success, and count your roll to Recruit for the Cause as one step better than what you rolled.

Success For a week, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recruit for the Cause or to Aid another PC to Recruit for the Cause at the settlement you assisted.

Critical Failure As success, but you gain a –2 circumstance penalty instead.

Recruit for the Cause

  • Exploration

You spend an hour speaking or corresponding with potential recruits, urging them to join the Hellbreakers' cause. You can do this once per week per settlement or target as defined by the adventure. Once you have recruited a troop, you cannot recruit them again from the same settlement until the next chapter begins.

The DC to recruit is a @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] or @Check[society|dc:28] very hard check for your level (DC 28 for level 7) using Diplomacy or Society. If more than one PC takes this activity at the same time, they can choose to roll separately or have one PC attempt the roll while the others Aid.

For each tier of reputation the Hellbreakers League has above ignored, the PCs gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, up to a maximum of +3. For each tier below ignored, the PCs take a –1 circumstance penalty.

Critical Success The residents enthusiastically let their best join the fight or send a solid battalion. As success, plus one advance unit troop of the settlement joins your cause.

Success As failure, plus one basic unit of the settlement joins your cause.

Failure A token @UUID[Actor.CKimybTvAdC2bkgK]{Conscript Squad} joins your noble cause. In @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring]{Chapter 8}, add the elite template to the squad. In Chapter 9, swap the unit to @UUID[Actor.MwOlQdz8hOfc87hj]{Line Infantry}.

Critical Failure You accidentally offend the settlement. You lose 1 Reputation Point.

Undeath in Southern Isger.name: Undeath in Southern Isger
Undeath in Southern Isger.text:
Undeath in Southern Isger

After the mission briefing, the game opens into a slight sandbox that proceeds mostly in downtime mode, with exploration and encounters in between. While the PCs have objectives with prospective deadlines, where they go and when is up to them. They might need to retreat and recuperate before heading out again after encounters with the undead roaming the lands.

Random Encounters: As they travel, the PCs are likely going to be ambushed by Illcayna's minions, who grow bold as her plan approaches fruition. Once per day, whenever the PCs travel more than 1 mile from their point of origin, make a secret @Check[flat|dc:5|traits:secret] against a DC of 5 + the number of days into Calistril (or the number of days passed since this chapter started). On a failure, the PCs encounter a group from the Undead Random Encounters table below within the next 24 hours. Use appropriate Flip-Mats that match the PCs' location, or reuse maps from previous chapters. If the PCs or the area they are in are under an effect that would suppress the rise of undead, conceal their presence from undead, or provide any similar benefit, the DC of the flat check decreases by 4.

Each time the PCs defeat a random encounter, you can forgo the flat check for 2 days. Once the curse in Gillamoor has been broken (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq.JournalEntryPage.07lthecurseofg00]{The Curse of Gillamoor}), the DC of the flat check is reduced and fixed at 5 (and possibly reduced to 1 with further protection). Once Illcayna has been destroyed, these encounters stop entirely except within 10 miles of Gillamoor if the curse there has not been dispelled.

New Assignments, Old Places.name: New Assignments, Old Places
New Assignments, Old Places.text:
New Assignments, Old Places

The Riotmongers, Rhokrag, and Jenvirick quickly divide tasks up for the Hellbreakers. They charge the PCs with aiding and recruiting from the familiar area south of Saringallow and north of the Chitterwood. This also puts the party in charge of negotiating with Thorngrip—an exceptionally important task, as Thorngrip's elders represent the Chitterwood much like how the Hellbreakers wish to represent the Isgeri outside the woods. Any promises the PCs make may become political obligations once the Hellbreakers free Isger.

As for solving the undead crisis, Alceo mentions he heard a rumor when he first came to the nation that a curse was the source of the undead. Phoebe chimes in and explains that the tale originated from merchants who traded in southern Isger. After all these years, however, present day trade caravans only know which routes are safe, not what or where they are avoiding. If the Hellbreakers ask the right questions and observe the undead, though, they should be able to triangulate the curse's location by process of elimination.

Below are questions the PCs might ask after they are given their tasks and the answers Alceo provides.

Which settlements are we covering? “From closest to furthest from Saringallow, you're in charge of Swiftrun, Stumpfield, Umok, and Vordia. Oh, and add Wolfpoint. There might be redeemable bandits hiding there from the undead.”

What should we do for the settlements? “Most will likely need fortifications, and some might have unique requests based on their situations. You can always escort folks to safety otherwise. Oh, and you can also send any recruits to Saringallow, though if that changes, I'll let you know.”

Do we have to search for the curse? Rhokrag perks up. “I'll bet you 100 gold that Maire and I can beat you lot to finding the hole these things are crawling out of while we're in the north.”

Make it 100 gold each and it's on. “So, 100 gold from each of you if we win? Deal!”

How much time do we have? “I'd like to know if Thorngrip will join us within three days from today,” Alceo says. “It's tight deadline, but the sooner we know, the more time we have to ease others into accepting them as allies. As for recruitment, let's reconvene on the 9th, though probably not in Saringallow. I'll update you about that later. As for the curse…” Alceo's voice drops to a whisper. “Rhokrag usually only bets if he believes he can get it done in a week. No pressure.”

What can we expect Thorngrip to demand? “I truly can't say. It's always difficult to guess what would help achieve reconciliation. I imagine Brakknap will help keep the terms reasonable.”

What are the rest of you doing? “Jenvirick will lead the Elidirans to recruit from around the capital. Rhokrag and Maire are headed to Breachill first, but they'll recruit as they return. Phoebe and I are bound for Logas; there's contradicting information about what happened there, so we need to see for ourselves how things are. Gram will be holding down Saringallow while we're away.”

How do we contact each other if we're all on the move? “…I knew I was forgetting something,” Alceo sighs. Gram presses a wand of dream message (4th-rank) into the cleric's hand with a wink.

If the PCs have other means of helping the Hellbreakers communicate, they can offer solutions. Otherwise, the Hellbreakers settle on contacting Gram (mysterious female halfling candler 4) in Saringallow, who will update Alceo daily. Alceo will then send a dream message each night to 11 individuals of his choice; the PCs should pick two in their party to be designated contacts. They can update Alceo on who to contact if need be.

Dampened Celebrations.name: Dampened Celebrations
Dampened Celebrations.text:
Dampened Celebrations

With the Elidir Hellbreakers settled in at Highfort, Saringallow's Hellbreakers host a celebratory dinner on the 1st of Calistril at Rhokrag's house. At the gathering, the PCs see familiar faces ranging from Rhokrag to Maire to Xerra; even Gram (see the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22215saring]{Saringallow Gazetteer}) makes a rare appearance. Phoebe and Alceo graciously host the celebrations, while Jenvirick represents the Elidir Hellbreakers with Sarevial and Otton.

Despite the dinner's celebratory intent, a sense of dread lingers over the guests. Maire ultimately broaches the subject and asks if people have heard about the undead. The PCs can share what they know, and Jenvirick sadly mentions how she heard that Logas fell to an undead incursion some days ago. Phoebe, however, shares a letter.

“This is a copy of the reply Vulaunex sent to Logas after the city requested aid. Begins much as expected. ‘We are aware of the situation developing…' and ‘I understand your concern…' Bureaucratic speak. I'll skip to the good part.

“‘Isger has greater problems than a few undead. The Hellbreakers are a pest that must be nipped in the bud before their dissidence spreads like a plague, though their self-righteous act may still be of some use. Your concerns are noted.'”

Alceo sighs. “The Hellbreakers have worked hard in the past months to earn the people's trust and show that we're an organization that takes action. With officials doing nothing about the crisis, people are frightened and desperate for help. We need to do all we can to help civilians find refuge against this undead entity and empower them to fight for themselves… and if the so-called leaders of Isger won't protect its people from the undead, we'll deal with it ourselves.”

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.TTHdIasHScP5NRNl]{Celebratory Dinner}

PCs can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,action:sense-motive|name:Sense Motive] check to Sense Motive or a @Check[society|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:23|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge at DC 23 to suss out Caeto's intent. On a success, they discern that the Hellknight hopes the Hellbreakers will play heroes. If they perish, it saves Caeto the trouble of hunting them, but if they live, they might still be weakened, making them easier to catch and dissolve.

The Hellbreakers have earned a reputation as an organization that fights for the people, and with no aid coming from government officials, civilians are itching to act and looking for guidance. The Hellbreakers just need to rally those ready to fight. Helping people secure their settlements or relocate to safety would make recruitment even easier. In fact, if the Hellbreakers solve the undead crisis once and for all, that in itself would cement their standing in the heart of the populace. With past successes like Hellknight Hill and Elidir under the Hellbreakers' belt, Alceo is confident that tackling the undead head-on is within the organization's capabilities. It's time to prove to Caeto how much he has underestimated them.

Warnings on the Horizon.name: Warnings on the Horizon
Warnings on the Horizon.text:
Warnings on the Horizon

Chapter Timeline

Below is a proposed timeline for specific events or deadlines featured in this chapter, though GMs are welcome to make adjustments to it as they see fit. Alceo shares any information that the Hellbreakers learn or any actions they take during the night of the day indicated via dream message. Meeting the suggested deadlines often gives extra rewards. Though missing them doesn't impact the overall questline, this can limit the PCs' options until they make up for them later.

 

Calistril 4726 ar

  • 1st: The celebration dinner takes place.
  • 4th: Deadline for seeking Thorngrip aid.
  • 6th: The Chitterwood Offensive successfully retakes Logas. Alceo negotiates an alliance with the Hellclad Goblins who saved Logas from the undead. Hellbreakers League recruits should convene in Logas from here on.
  • 7th: Maire discovers Gillamoor is the source of the undead curse if the PCs haven't.
  • 9th: If the PCs have yet to investigate Gillamoor, the Riotmongers visit instead and discover that Illcayna is behind the rising undead. They fail to break the curse. This is the deadline to reconvene in Logas.
  • 10th: The Hellbreakers army leaves Logas and marches toward Finder's Gulch.
  • 13th: The Hellbreakers army arrives on the outskirts of Finder's Gulch.
  • 19th: If she isn't interrupted, Illcayna completes her curse and sacrifices Isger to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22214plotso.JournalEntryPage.14plotsofthepa00]{Urgathoa} at dusk.

The Hellbreakers have been busy since their explosive exit out of Elidir. During the party's downtime, they have settled into a new headquarters at Highfort, an abandoned hobgoblin fortress once used during the Goblinblood Wars. As it is only a few days' trek from Saringallow, Highfort's location enables the two Hellbreakers branches to cooperate even as they remain isolated from one another. This foresight becomes very important in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring]{Chapter 8}.

As Abadius comes to an end, reports of undead activity surface in southern Isger. At first, the troubles sound typical, but then the attacks increase exponentially. Settlements are overrun, and their residents flee for safety. The PCs can get a glimpse of the developing threat through the following methods, if they are available:

  • Grizzo the goblin forager delivers a letter from the gnome official Ioan Marblemug. While Umok doesn't require assistance yet, Captain Ioan finds it prudent to alert the PCs that undead are becoming an issue. If Fesimwyth “Fessy” Finwinkle, the Abadaran cleric from the gala, is alive and friendly, she co-signs the letter.
  • One of the founders of Stumpfield, Erk Oilfingers the goblin painter, passes by Saringallow while leading refugees north. Erk is angry that their requests for aid to the official Isgeri army were ignored.
  • If Lezinia, the human singer from the gala, is alive, she crosses paths with the party as a guest performer at the Fiend's Finale. Lezinia urges the PCs to leave Isger, for she has heard that Caeto Vulaunex has ordered his forces to ignore the undead problem in favor of catching Hellbreakers.

Wight Queen's Thaw.name: Wight Queen's Thaw
Wight Queen's Thaw.text:
Chapter 7: Wight Queen's Thaw

Once upon a forgotten time, a king now nameless inherited the crown from his deceased younger brother, Grand Prince Cyricas, who had perished as a result of his own hubris in lands far away from home. The King-Now-Nameless demanded a tribute worthy his arrogance: the subjugation of the lands between the mountains. For centuries, the king's ancestors had coveted these lands and bit and clawed at them to no avail. The Twelve Tribes of the Seasons, which had protected the region as one since before the sun was swallowed, were an impassable wood of birch, maple, and oak.

But even a great wood is nothing compared to the forest of swords and armor the King-Now-Nameless sent to do his bidding. Many of his warriors fell, some to spears and swords and others to schemes and deceit. An entire generation forgot what it meant to live in peace, knowing only fear, fighting, and fleeing. Capturing the land was not enough to satiate the King-Now-Nameless; he demanded the tribes be slaughtered, for he hungered for more than the title of conqueror.

The Chitterwood Offensive

A few days after he declared martial law in Elidir, Caeto Vulaunex directed his Hellknights to seize Logas. This unfortunately placed his comrades in the line of fire when undead rose in southern Isger. The Hellknights in Logas were ultimately routed, and the survivors who stumbled into the Chitterwood were captured by goblins who acquired their gear and modified it for their own purposes. In Calistril, these goblins with Hellknight gear successfully repel an undead invasion on the Chitterwood, then liberate Logas in what will come to be known as the Chitterwood Offensive.

Hunted, starving, and hiding, one desperate tribe painted their skin with the ashes of their dead. Through the ways of the Speakers of the Pale, they called upon their predecessors, the spirits of the land, and the patron deities of the Twelve Tribes. In the bleak silence of winter, one voice answered. Feast upon the harvest your enemies have wrought, the voice soothed. Become the herald of my winter and survive in spite of death—forever.

Eventually, the tribe was caught. Those who survived scattered to the winds like leaves in fall, but those who didn't rose as wights. Before long, an immortal army stood ready to liberate the land and destroy those who had slaughtered them. In fear, Taldor deposed their nameless, bloodthirsty grand prince, but it was too late—in a little over a decade, the undead drove the invaders out and made plans to march south.

Unwilling to let their legacy become that of bringing undeath to others, what remained of the Twelve Tribes allied with the Taldane army for one last war. They were so few in number that by the time the last wight was destroyed, so too was the culture of the Twelve Tribes of the Seasons. In tribute to the lost, Taldor commemorated the tribes as the Isgeri, a name some say means “those who were sacrificed,” or perhaps “those who sacrificed themselves.” The definitive meaning is unfortunately lost to time.

For some Isgeri descendants, such as the Alonnors and their fellow cultists, the ending of this story did not matter—if they considered the tale to have ended at all. They held the ancient pledge to their savior as sacred, but Isger was not freed from its conqueror. It fell to Taldor's rule, after all, and then to Cheliax's. Isger is, therefore, yet destined to become the realm of the Pallid Princess.

@UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22216advent.JournalEntryPage.16campaignrole03]{Illcayna Alonnor} has believed since youth that she has a pivotal role to play in this grand destiny. Her feverish visions and transformation into a Child of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22214plotso.JournalEntryPage.14plotsofthepa00]{Urgathoa} only strengthened that sense of self-importance. For the past century, she has secretly sowed discord throughout the nation, instigating the Goblinblood Wars through Ezio Gaeta and cursing a merchant to afflict Gillamoor with a deadly curse. Her plots would have required another century to reach proper culmination, but the return of Tar-Baphon and the descent of warshards during the Godsrain accelerated her plans.

While most in Isger regard Illcayna as an exaggerated urban legend, the Wight Mother of Isger and her cult know they are close to reaching their goals and finally claiming the land for their goddess. With the murder of Hedvend VI distracting the political movers in Elidir, she is on the cusp of victory. Should she manage to curse the entire nation and deliver the land to Urgathoa, her goddess shall gain a place on Golarion where she is singularly revered, not reviled.

Concluding the Chapter.name: Concluding the Chapter
Concluding the Chapter.text:
Concluding the Chapter

Once the PCs defeat and capture Sephone, the other forces at Sarini Manor also submit. Prisoners are taken to Highfort, where the Hellbreakers' army slowly assembles. The morning after they captured Sarini Manor, the PCs learn that Caeto has been delayed in his return by a series of “unforeseen circumstances.” This development has bought the Hellbreakers precious breathing room; the liberation of Saringallow awaits.

Fiendish Records.name: Fiendish Records
Fiendish Records.text:
O15. Fiendish RecordsSevere 8

Though part of the manor collapsed, the records the Sarinis penned about their grisly deeds survived. Like the portal room, this area is completely dark.

O15. Fiendish RecordsSevere 8

@UUID[Actor.0WOlf545priSPdSX]{Kylixes (2)} @UUID[Actor.gCU3zxcd8mZEAsvc]{Instillo} @UUID[Actor.eRN6xtgrJqaB7N5p]{Sephone Haugini}

Creatures: While the instillo fights the PCs in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ashutportalu00]{O14}, Sephone applies as many buffing spells as she can, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aAbfKn8maGjJjk2W]{Mystic Armor}, so she can ambush the party while they're still in that room. She orders her three other devil companions to focus on flanking and take down PCs who are most likely to disrupt her spellcasting. She summons a @UUID[Actor.W4Jcqxl3l6rsUvgV]{Flame Drake} using her @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon} spell if she has it, then uses her offensive spells paired with Channel Hellfire. As the devils are immune to fire, she has no fear of hurting them. Sephone uses Widen Spell when she can to catch as many PCs in the area of her spells. Otherwise, she prioritizes targeting healers and casters.

The devils and any summoned creatures fight to the death. If Sephone falls below 60 HP or if only one devil remains, she orders them to seek help from Saringallow. If all devils and minions are destroyed or banished or Sephone falls below 30 HP, she surrenders. If Sephone dies, the PCs lose 5 Reputation Points.

A Shut Portal.name: A Shut Portal
A Shut Portal.text:
O14. A Shut PortalLow 8

This room has been left dark. The pentagram at the room's center is still fresh, as if someone has retraced it.

O14. A Shut PortalLow 8

@UUID[Actor.gCU3zxcd8mZEAsvc]{Instillo}

Creature: Sephone secured the service of an instillo to delay the PCs. They fight to the death.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.qCuMPUv7AQTpXUqw]{Corner}
In the corner of the room are a collection of rare chalks and ritual components worth 200 gp.

Day 7: Confrontation.name: Day 7: Confrontation
Day 7: Confrontation.text:
Day 7: Confrontation

The PCs must end their infiltration on the night of the 18th of Pharast, as the Hellbreakers expect Caeto to return by tomorrow. This confrontation can be triggered earlier at your discretion, particularly if all the troops and NPCs guarding the manor and Sephone's staff have been defeated. When infiltration ends, for each troop or NPC they haven't permanently removed, the PCs gain 2 AP. Sephone and fey creatures are excluded from this calculation. The GM should tally up the total number of AP the PCs have at this point. For every 5 points, the PCs gain 1 Liberation Point, which will apply in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat]{Chapter 9}.

Location: If the basement hasn't been excavated, Sephone sends the instillo to intercept the PCs at area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ballroom000000]{O3} while she waits in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08diabolistoff00]{O10}. Otherwise, the encounters take place as indicated below.

Rooftops.name: Rooftops
Rooftops.text:
O13. RooftopsLow 8

With the collapse of the basement, part of Sarini Manor sank down by an entire floor, resulting in a part of the roof now becoming level with the second floor.

O13. RooftopsLow 8

@UUID[Actor.66OsLQ6NAuQSYM4z]{Breathless Thickets (3)}

Hazards: There are several Large patches of breathless orchards that have been wintering here. As the breathless thickets haven't fed in a while, they look less menacing than they are.

Opportunity: A PC who succeeds at a @Check[nature|dc:29] or @Check[survival|dc:29] check can remove a thicket without triggering it and unleash it in an area of their choice. If Sephone knows the PCs removed the breathless thickets, the PCs must succeed at a @Check[deception|dc:25] check before or after they unleash the breathless thickets or gain 3 AP.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.atEGkQTexevy4ZCN]{Sephone's Reward} @UUID[Actor.ieDs3lXWJZxmy8Cc]{Thicket}
Sephone has put up a reward for anyone who can get rid of all the orchard patches. If the PCs destroy or remove all the breathless thickets, she rewards them with a pair of armbands of athleticism. The PCs also find a pair of boots of bounding entangled in one of the thickets.

Study Remnants.name: Study Remnants
Study Remnants.text:
O12. Study RemnantsModerate 8

The study's remains are a ruin of its former self. All furniture, broken or whole, are pushed into the rotunda.

O12. Study RemnantsModerate 8

@UUID[Actor.vAb6X5XBOAJdd1z2]{Redcaps (2)} @UUID[Actor.kDT0KrsurOcm3WEF]{Elananx} @UUID[Actor.IogtYVxnE6JLEDdK]{Rustflesh}

Creatures: The troops move out of this area at night to avoid the elananx and redcaps under the command of a pukwudgie named Rustflesh. He would rather like to evict both humanoids and other fey out of the manor, and an alliance with him is unlikely. Fortunately, Rustflesh fights to the death against the PCs, unaware of how powerful they are. If the PCs defeat Rustflesh and befriend the redcaps, they recruit a weak @UUID[Actor.izd6CNhovgFGH4oJ]{Redcap Brigade}.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.OWZaC2Y1JRkGQZTL]{Rustflesh}
If the PCs defeat Rustflesh, they can take a greater pendant of the occult and a greater darkvision elixir off him.

Ruined Master Bedroom.name: Ruined Master Bedroom
Ruined Master Bedroom.text:
O11. Ruined Master Bedroom

The manor's once-splendid master bedroom has an unfortunate hole in it from the collapsed roof. The commander NPC usually stands out on the balcony of the master bedroom, while the troops are inside and also stationed along the walkway and area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08studyremnant00]{O12} during the day and afternoon.

Complication: If the PCs successfully tamper with Sephone's items, she moves to sleep here during the morning shift under the watch of the guards.

Diabolist Office and Quarters.name: Diabolist Office and Quarters
Diabolist Office and Quarters.text:
O10. Diabolist Office and Quarters

Sephone converted the bathroom to her private office and quarters. Other than a hefty desk taken from the main bedroom, very few furnishings decorate this area. Sephone even opts for a bedroll instead of a proper bed.

Opportunity: Sephone is usually here and sleeps in the morning. This changes once the excavation in the garden (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7}) unearths the basement (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ashutportalu00]{O14}). From the 14th and onward, Sephone spends her time in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ashutportalu00]{O14} except for meetings and sleep. Each door has a good lock, and Sephone expects the security to keep people out of her room.

If the PCs are allied with Nixa's army, they get a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to get into the room. If the PCs allied with the mercenaries, the number of checks needed to unlock the doors decrease by two each. Access to Sephone's room allows the PCs to tamper with her items; if the PCs succeed at three @Check[arcana|dc:26], @Check[occultism|dc:26], or @Check[religion|dc:26] checks, Sephone loses a spell of each rank from her prepared spell list, determined by the GM. Unless a PC rolled a critical failure, which causes the PCs to gain 2 AP, Sephone assumes the tampering to be due to vicious fey pranks. If a PC critically succeeds, they also learn that Sephone has contracted an instillo and coartis to serve her.

Sephone is away for the entire day on the 16th of Pharast. She doesn't reveal why she was gone, only that she headed into Saringallow. PCs who Investigate this room on the 16th can attempt a @Check[arcana|dc:28|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:28|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge to recognize preparations for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual.

Forgotten Connection: While she mainly follows Caeto into Isger to secure a recommendation for her to become a Hellknight signifier of the Order of the Gate, Sephone has an ulterior motive: she wants to know if Caeto knew who her parents were. Sephone was a Goblinblood orphan, only a few months old when Caeto's contingent rescued her from goblinoids who'd raided a village and kidnapped its villagers. Despite being told to leave the child behind for the rescued folks to take to safety, Caeto then personally cared for Sephone until he found an orphanage in Haugin's Ear that was willing to take her in. Caeto has forgotten about this small act of kindness completely, while Sephone hasn't. She attempted and failed to write a letter to him a number of times, leaving a stack of drafts behind. The PCs can find out about this motivation of hers if they succeed at a @Check[arcana|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:decipher-writing|name:Decipher Writing] or @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,secret,action:decipher-writing|name:Decipher Writing] check to Decipher Writing.

Reward: If the PCs discover Sephone's past connection with Caeto, they gain 30 XP.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.1HQVPFKbsWetT5IT]{Belongings}
Among Sephone's belongings are a jade bauble and a greater emerald grasshopper.

Guest Bedroom.name: Guest Bedroom
Guest Bedroom.text:
O9. Guest BedroomModerate 8

This room is meant to accommodate any guests who might visit the manor. It's only lit if a guest, or guests, stays over. If the PCs were hired by Sephone separately, they're given this room to use.

O9. Guest BedroomModerate 8

@UUID[Actor.vAb6X5XBOAJdd1z2]{Redcaps (4)} @UUID[Actor.kDT0KrsurOcm3WEF]{Elananx}

Creatures: Sephone rarely has guests over, partly because this room is one of the places in which fey especially like to ambush people. Whenever one or more creatures sleep in the room, some redcaps and an elananx show up after 1 hour to attack them. These redcaps, if made indifferent or better in attitude, let the PCs know about the tyrannical rule of Rustflesh and where to find him (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08studyremnant00]{O12}).

Researcher Dormitory.name: Researcher Dormitory
Researcher Dormitory.text:
O8. Researcher Dormitory

Sephone's research staff sleeps here. The door and windows are sprinkled with cold iron dust.

Complication or Opportunity: The researchers cast an alarm spell in the room with the audible alarm option. While triggering this alarm increases the PCs' AP by 1, triggering it in three consecutive shifts results in Sephone demanding the researchers make it silent. This allows the PCs to draw only a demonologist to the room if the alarm is triggered subsequently. After both demonologists have been removed, Sephone must cast the spell herself. This gives the PCs 1 EP when they start their shift.

Garden and Excavation.name: Garden and Excavation
Garden and Excavation.text:
O7. Garden and Excavation

The poison garden is overgrown and perilous to walk through with exposed skin. The excavation has dug 10 feet deep into the ground, reachable by sturdy ladders. A ring of torches surrounds the excavation. The only other lighting in the area are the torches the guards carry when they patrol.

Opportunity: With so many poisonous plants around, trips, falls, or a gust of wind can turn dangerous. If the PCs succeed at three @Check[nature|dc:24] or @Check[survival|dc:24] or @Check[crafting|dc:26] checks, they successfully set up a trap and gain 1 EP. The watchmage guarding on the next shift must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] against @Damage[(4d10+22)[poison,non-lethal]] damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also sickened until the end of the shift. This trap can be used three times before Sephone has all plants removed. All troops and their commander NPCs become permanently sickened 1 from contact with the plants during the cleanup.

On the 14th of Pharast, the excavation team reaches the basement (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ashutportalu00]{O14}). The creatures here take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks from this day on, as they become concerned with what's underground.

Scene Notes Macro

@UUID[Macro.9jn8ziTSd3ARkaG2]{Finish Excavation}

Opens a hole to the basement, and activates the Teleporter Region.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.QDj9zFZnRezLKLx8]{Gazebo}
A basilisk eye sits in the gazebo, left behind by a commander.

A Fey's Throne.name: A Fey's Throne
A Fey's Throne.text:
O6. A Fey's ThroneTrivial 8

The only way to enter into this unlit area of the manor is by climbing over the rubble from area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ballroom000000]{O3}. While the dining room remains relatively intact, the breakfast room and pantry have been crushed by the study above. The alchemy set that used to be in the room is in shambles. The floors creak when stepped on, imposing a –4 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks to Hide, Sneak, and conduct other similar activities.

Creature: An empress katroome by the name of Spring's Crown (haughty agender empress katroome 8) has taken the study portion of the room as its “throne room.” This magical beast is an advanced form of the caterpillar-shaped katroome, usually the result of significant exposure to primal ley lines or the First World. Unlike normal katroomes, an empress katroome is a fey creature.

Like many of its kind, Spring's Crown believes itself to be the monarch of its surroundings—Sarini Manor, in this case. Though none of the fey here obeys its commands, it refers to them as its adoring subject anyway. The other fey avoid the katroome because in addition to its pacifying aura, Spring's Crown is too condescending to stand.

If a creature enters the study area, Spring's Crown demands the creature to bow, using command if needed. The katroome then demands the PCs to report why they haven't paid their taxes. The undead are gone, so there are no excuses. If the PCs destroyed the breathless thickets in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08rooftopsunde00]{O13}, Spring's Crown also demands restitution as it was looking forward to having a beautiful garden in the coming months.

O6. A Fey's ThroneTrivial 8

@UUID[Actor.Kn4gMB9odEwmR2yZ]{Spring's Crown}

If the PCs try to play dumb or otherwise refuse to treat the katroome with reverence, Spring's Crown attacks, though only to drive the PCs out of area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08afeysthroneu00]{O6}. If reduced to 30 Hit Points or fewer, the katroome uses translocate to flee and returns after a day fully healed. It remains arrogant but avoids attacking the party on subsequent encounters.

If the PCs successfully Make an Impression to make the katroome friendly, Spring's Crown says it shall overlook the missed payments if the PCs evict the current “squatters” from the premises. In return, the PCs can become its knights, which would allow them to hold a property of their choosing… like the manor itself.

Opportunity: A helpful Spring's Crown can be a commander NPC in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat]{Chapter 9}.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.teZkE7nHUmogYRKG]{Spring’s Crown's Reward}
If the PCs successfully make all fey in Sarini Manor friendly or better, Spring's Crown rewards them with a resilient rune, calling it a medal of diplomatic honor. The PCs can also loot this rune if Spring's Crown is defeated or killed.

Forgotten Bedroom.name: Forgotten Bedroom
Forgotten Bedroom.text:
O5. Forgotten Bedroom

This dark bedroom full of moss used to be a guest bedroom on the second floor. It survived the fall relatively intact and now rests on the first floor. Only the windows were shattered.

This room is a security blind spot. So long as the PCs successfully Hide from the troops in the garden (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7}), they can Sneak into this room by succeeding at a @Check[athletics|dc:22|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check to Climb on the outside. The PCs can even take a long rest here so long as they make no noise and stay in the dark.

Entrance.name: Entrance
Entrance.text:
O4. Entrance

What was once a beautiful sitting room is now armed to the teeth like the interior of a guard's tower. At least a third of the guards on the first floor of the manor are situated here. The watch officer leading the line infantry usually passes time in the cloak room off to the left, unless the PCs have 5 or more AP (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08messhall000000]{O2}).

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.NsyiMv9xu2pXAOrY]{Cloak Room}
Someone left a greater devilwing badge in the cloak room.

Ballroom.name: Ballroom
Ballroom.text:
O3. Ballroom

The east half of this ballroom has collapsed and is mostly covered in rubble, except for a corridor that's accessible over a 3-foot-tall railing. The area is brightly lit by both standing torches and the fireplace, though it's not unusual for the fey to put these fires out to spook the soldiers.

The rubble reaches 10 feet high and requires a successful @Check[athletics|dc:26|traits:move,skill,action:climb|name:Climb] check to Climb. The PCs can reach area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08afeysthroneu00]{O6} by succeeding at this check to Climb over the rubble in the southeast. Doing so attracts the attention of the troops guarding this area. If the PCs haven't allied with the Isgeri army or mercenaries, climbing the rubble in view of the troops increases their AP by 5 if the PCs are observed climbing.

The troops guarding the first floor are mostly concentrated here. They pay attention to what's going on in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08entrance000000]{O4} but ignore noises from areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08forgottenbed00]{O5} or @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08afeysthroneu00]{O6} unless they're absolutely certain an ally (the PCs count if they've infiltrated as hired hands) is calling for help.

Complication or Opportunity: Every time the PCs reach 10 AP and every 5 points above 10, all troops are gathered here to be searched. If the PCs are hiding among the troops, they must succeed at a @Check[deception|dc:26], @Check[diplomacy|dc:26], or @Check[thievery|dc:26] check to conceal suspicious items and keep up their disguise. The PCs can also attempt a @Check[stealth|dc:28] check to sneak out of the search. If they're allied with Nixa's army, the DC decreases by 5. If they're allied with the mercenaries, the DC increases by 5. The search lasts an entire shift, which gives the PCs 1 EP each if they evade, pass, or otherwise escape inspection. This EP expires at the end of the next shift.

Mess Hall.name: Mess Hall
Mess Hall.text:
O2. Mess Hall

This room, once meant for recreation, has been converted to a dining room for staff and security to have their meals. The fireplace is used as the stove. There's at least a couple of guards posted in this room at all times, though they are usually slacking off and take a -2 circumstance penalty to their Perception checks.

Complication: If the PCs have 5 or more AP, the watch officer leading the troop on the first floor guards this area themselves. They're quick to call for assistance from any of the nearby rooms if attacked.

Opportunity: @UUID[Actor.nLWxAxYHV0zj14Mb]{Mess Hall}
There's usually a stockpile of 20 or so minor elixirs of life here, replenished daily. If the PCs hide, take, or steal the entire stash twice, the privilege is withdrawn, and all of Sephone's staff and security become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}. The PCs gain 1 EP.

Library.name: Library
Library.text:
O1. Library Moderate 8

As Saringallow took away most books of value, there remained a lot of empty shelves for Sephone to fill with her own collection. Any PC who succeeds at a @Check[arcana|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[religion|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge recognizes that most of her collection is about teleportation, conjurations, summoning, and Hell. In the day and afternoon, the room is kept brightly lit. At night, all fires are put out, though the visiting fey bring a small lamp that makes it dim light instead.

O1. LibraryModerate 8

@UUID[Actor.ABcLxdURUZZji0vN]{Elite Draxies (4)} @UUID[Actor.lPsGzBTsIGJoRlWk]{Pixies (4)}

Creatures: During the morning and afternoon shifts, Sephone's research team gathers here. Every other day on odd dates, Sephone calls half of the team (one of each NPC type) to report to her in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08diabolistoff00]{O10} during the afternoon shift. At night, draxies and pixies appear, discussing how best to evict the humans. If the PCs express that they also want to remove the people here, the fey's attitude automatically becomes indifferent, and they can be further influenced from there. If they become helpful, the PCs can convince them to help with the opportunity here. Evicting the researchers from this room is enough for these fey to consider any past debts paid, and they become willing to help the PCs tackle any enemy on the first floor. They refuse to touch the katroome in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08afeysthroneu00]{O6} and don't go upstairs since that's redcap territory.

Opportunity: It isn't difficult to make one of the ancient shelves topple. Setting up this trap requires the PCs to succeed at three @Check[crafting|dc:26], @Check[engineering-lore|dc:26], or @Check[thievery|dc:26] checks. If there are researchers in the room, the PCs would need to Hide to conceal their sabotage. There's also the option of pushing the shelf over, which only requires a successful @Check[athletics|dc:22] check. A creature or creatures targeted by the bookshelf or who trigger the trap must attempt a Reflex save against the DC of the skill the PCs used to set up the trap. On a failure, they take @Damage[4d10+22[bludgeoning]] damage and become trapped beneath the bookshelf. They must Escape against the DC of the trap. Each round the creature remains stuck under the bookshelf, they take another @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]] damage at the end of their turn. The damage is automatically nonlethal. This trap can be used twice before Sephone has the shelves reinforced; if the PCs befriended the fey in this area, they can use this trap two more times after. Sephone then closes off the room and moves the researchers to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08messhall000000]{O2}. Setting up the traps or successfully pushing over a shelf gives the PCs 1 EP per trap.

If the PCs critically fail their check to set up the contraption, they must immediately save against the trap themselves. They also gain 2 AP the first time this occurs and 4 AP if it happens a second time.

Scene Notes Macro

@UUID[Macro.A6Rz5jMhJiNyPF9B]{Collapse Bookshelf}

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.kRaQQNRXoWvttlBq]{Table}
An envisioning aeon stone and a 5th-rank scroll of banishment rest on the table.

Day 3 to Day 6: Shift by Shift.name: Day 3 to Day 6: Shift by Shift
Day 3 to Day 6: Shift by Shift.text:
Day 3 to Day 6: Shift by Shift

The third day begins with a commotion in the garden; the excavation has finally uncovered the rumored corrupted basement. The guards complain that with Sephone's habit of sleeping in the morning, some poor sods are going to be up in the night as prime targets for the fey to attack. The PCs can learn where in the manor fey have been spotted and at what times if there's a restriction.

From this day onward, the PCs can decide what they wish to do shift by shift. The obstacle in each room is generally the creatures in it. Each area also details if there are opportunities or complications and the requirements or trigger for them, such as time of day. The PCs can visit up to three areas per shift without drawing attention. For each area after the third, the party gains 1 AP.

Focus by Day: For easier encounter management, you can have the PCs focus on befriending or removing the fey on Day 3 (areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08libraryundef00]{O1}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08afeysthroneu00]{O6}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08guestbedroom00]{O9}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08studyremnant00]{O12}), seeking out opportunities and learning about complications in advance on Day 4 (areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08libraryundef00]{O1}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08researcherdo00]{O8}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08diabolistoff00]{O10} in particular), then taking out the enemies on Days 5 and 6. The PCs should know that the night of the 18th of Pharast (or Day 7 of their infiltration) is when the Hellbreakers must take the manor, by force if necessary.

Creature Management.name: Creature Management
Creature Management.text:
Creature Management

For easier management, the GMs should use the same creature for the security and staff across the different shifts. Troops don't recover Hit Points naturally as time progress, though they can still be healed by items and spells during the shift. The PCs are limited to bringing troop creatures to the next Hit Point threshold on each shift. Once the troop falls below the threshold, it's removed from the map until the next shift begins. At 0 Hit Points, the troop is removed permanently. The Hit Point threshold and reduction in size helps represent soldiers being redistributed to cover shifts and how some areas become neglected from reduced numbers.

For the watchmage and watch officers, these NPCs return to full Hit Points between shifts. Despite this, the PCs need to defeat or capture them only once on any shift to remove the creature permanently from the map. Rumor of their colleague's disappearance or misfortune makes the others resign or desert their post. The same applies to the research team.

If a troop loses their commander NPC, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If two or more researchers go missing or are defeated, the other research staff become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. Any point a creature reaches frightened 4, it flees from the area and manor altogether; the PCs can consider the creature permanently defeated and remove it from the map.

Infiltration Day 2: Joining the Rotation.name: Infiltration Day 2: Joining the Rotation
Infiltration Day 2: Joining the Rotation.text:
Infiltration Day 2: Joining the Rotation

XP Reward

The XP value based on creature level for level 8 PCs are below.

  • Creature 4: 10 XP
  • Creature 5: 15 XP
  • Creature 6: 20 XP
  • Creature 7: 30 XP
  • Creature 8: 40 XP
  • Creature 9: 60 XP

The second day of infiltration is dedicated to feeling out the exact number of enemies and their whereabouts over the course of a day. The PCs have 6 rounds to obtain as many Victory Points as possible. Each round, they can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:22|traits:concentrate,secret,action:seek|name:Seek] check to Seek, a @Check[warfare-lore|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,action:investigate|name:Investigate] check to Investigate, or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:26|traits:exploration,skill,secret,action:gather-information|name:Gather Information] or @Check[deception|dc:26] check to Gather Information. Once they've reached 6 Victory Points, the PCs can also attempt a @Check[isger-lore|dc:24] or @Check[nature|dc:24] check to learn more about the fey that was here before Sephone took over. Any time the PCs critically fail a check, they gain 1 Awareness Point.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Macro.kYKwf8pQ5vxxia2w]{Sarini Manor Nighttime Ambience Toggle}

0 Victory Points: The lighting conditions for the outdoors depend on the time of day (bright for day, dark for night), while the interior is generally well lit except when an area isn't in use. The soldiers try to avoid having dim light, as that's the optimal lighting conditions for fey. Most doors, except those to area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08diabolistoff00]{O10}, are poor in quality.

2 Victory Points: There are three shifts per day, named morning (8 a.m. to 4 p.m.), afternoon (4 p.m. to midnight) and night shift (midnight to 8 a.m.). Most guards have only a single work shift a day. They generally eat before and after work. Most return after a shift to sleep, though it's not unknown for slackers to return late and end up needing an extra shift off before they work again.

4 Victory Points: The PCs learn that during each shift, there's one line infantry and one elite watch officer guarding areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ballroom000000]{O3} and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08entrance000000]{O4}, and another line infantry and watch officer guarding areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08ruinedmaster00]{O11} and the corridor on the second floor. A draconic fumecrux and a watchmage guard the exterior at the front entrance and in the garden (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7}). The dormitory for the troops is beyond the map. If necessary, the GM can use the ambush site to represent the encampment. The GM should keep these creatures visible on the map for the PCs at all times.

6 Victory Points: Sephone has a private research team of two kylixes, three zealots of Asmodeus, and two demonologists. These researchers are in the library (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08libraryundef00]{O1}) during the day and afternoon shifts and in their sleeping quarters (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08researcherdo00]{O8}) at night. Every other day on the even dates, Sephone calls half of the team (one of each NPC type) to meet with her in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08diabolistoff00]{O10} during the afternoon shift. The GM should keep these creatures visible on the map for the PCs at all times.

8 Victory Points: There's quite a bit of dangerous flora around. The PCs learn about the poisonous plants in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7} and breathless thickets in area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08rooftopsunde00]{O13}. They also learn that Sephone has put up a bounty for anyone willing to do pruning.

10 Victory Points: Some fey seized Sarini Manor shortly after Illcayna's death, calling it an “overdue payment.” Bitter and vengeful after Sephone drove them off, these fey might make good allies. That said, the Hellbreakers will likely need to negotiate with the fey too… or send them back to the First World permanently.

12 Victory Points: The ancient Kellid tribes used to commune with the fey. The fey probably don't understand that the tributes stopped with the tribes' extinction. While fey such as the empress katroome, draxies, and pixies are unfriendly but likely to let the PCs explain or retreat, the redcaps and elananxes are hostile and attack on sight.

14 Victory Points: The redcaps are under the tyrannical rule of a pukwudgie named Rustflesh. If the PCs cured the redcaps of red drip in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq]{Chapter 7}, the redcaps and elananxes are unfriendly but willing to talk. Otherwise, befriending the redcaps might make them willing allies, but it'll likely require defeating Rustflesh.

Infiltration Day 2: Joining the Rotation

@UUID[Actor.2tlwsAYKJg10GVAE]{Kylixes (2)} @UUID[Actor.iSe8Ck6iiIhi2j5I]{Elite Watch Officers (2)} @UUID[Actor.IOnqq6qmrdsfIvDQ]{Zealots of Asmodeus (3)} @UUID[Actor.F8dbItoiyV02FNaM]{Watchmage} @UUID[Actor.nsg5FiO260fvOynn]{Line Infantry (2)} @UUID[Actor.tg9klV8fqiqfaR1x]{Demonologists (2)} @UUID[Actor.6UhjZeEdJRLUTjdh]{Draconic Fumecrux}

Reward: For the creatures listed above, reward XP when a creature is permanently removed from the map.

Treasure: Every time the PCs permanently remove a troop, the Hellbreakers prepare a moderate elixir of life. For every NPC removed, the PCs receive a common consumable of level 8 or less. If the NPC removed is a watchmage or demonologist, the rarity can be uncommon. The PCs must pick up their reward at Vulaunex Ranch, which is an hour's trek from Sarini Manor.

In Case of Failure….name: In Case of Failure…
In Case of Failure….text:
In Case of Failure…

If the PCs end up failing both encounters, they can get hired as independent contractors by Sephone, who's short on hands. The PCs must spend 8 hours each day taking the Earn Income downtime activity and will need to explore the manor to know what each room does. On the other hand, they do get a room of their own (area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08guestbedroom00]{O9}) and have more flexibility in where and when they go. You should run the rest of this chapter more as a dungeon crawl if the PCs go this route. The same applies if the PCs choose Stealth to sneak in and out through area @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08forgottenbed00]{O5}.

Dishonorably Dismissed.name: Dishonorably Dismissed
Dishonorably Dismissed.text:
Dishonorably Dismissed

Should the PCs replace or ally with one group and arrive at the manor with the other, they can attempt to convince Sephone to dismiss the other with prejudice. This encounter uses the Victory Point system (GM Core 184). The PCs are given 4 rounds to obtain 8 Victory Points. The PCs must succeed at a @Check[deception|dc:26|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:26|traits:action:make-an-impression|name:Make an Impression] check to Make an Impression on Sephone, a @Check[intimidation|dc:28|traits:auditory,concentrate,emotion,exploration,linguistic,mental,skill,action:coerce|name:Coerce] check to Coerce their opponent (the drill sergeant or Nixa) and push back their opponent's claims, or a @Check[warfare-lore|dc:24] check to demonstrate they're capable guards who can protect the manor. You can accept other skill checks and reasoning at your discretion.

If the PCs obtain 8 or more Victory Points, Sephone dismisses the opposing group's service and welcomes the PCs into the fold. Award the PCs any XP they would've gotten if they defeated the opposition. If the PCs obtained 1 to 7 Victory Points, both groups stay. If the PCs ended up with 0 or less Victory Points, Sephone allows both groups to stay, but the PCs gain 2 AP.

Reward: If the PCs gain access to Sarini Manor through either of the two groups they can ambush, they gain an additional 30 XP, even if the other group wasn't fired. They also receive a tour as part of their orientation as security of Sarini Manor. The PCs learn the basic functions of areas @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08libraryundef00]{O1} to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08entrance000000]{O4}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08gardenandexc00]{O7} to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22208spring.JournalEntryPage.08rooftopsunde00]{O13}.

The Caustic and Cautious.name: The Caustic and Cautious
The Caustic and Cautious.text:
The Caustic and CautiousModerate 8

In comparison to the other contingent, the southern clearing is disorganized. These mercenaries came together at the last minute for this assignment, so they don't work very well together nor make great company. Some are Isgeri Slayers, while the rest used to work for the unscrupulous Azri family. The mercenaries spend their time huddled by the fire, playing games, and drinking. Most keep their voices low out of fear of offending the fey rumored to be in the region. Any PCs who succeeds at a @Check[perception|dc:26] can hear them share gossip about the kinds of fey appearing in Sarini Manor.

The Caustic and CautiousModerate 8

@UUID[Actor.mlQbNOg78QHSXp0f]{Weak Mercenary Band} @UUID[Actor.JS1C1LORSu3rddhv]{Drill Sergeant}

Creatures: What the mercenary band lacks in coordination, they make up for in numbers. If attacked outright, those hurt raise the alarm. Mercenaries swarm out into a single troop that does its best to keep the PCs in their squares. The drill sergeant leading them stay in the distance, picking off targets with ranged attacks. Both flee and seek help from the Isgeri infantry when they fall below 30 Hit Points.

If the Isgeri army is attacked, the mercenaries assume they were attacked by fey for failing to keep their voices down. They only check on the camp once things fall quiet again, though they're doing so more to scavenge for valuables than to help. Like the Isgeri army, if the PCs capture the mercenary band and commander, they're held at Highfort.

Fear and Greed: The PCs can exploit the band's fear or greed. If the PCs succeed at three @Check[deception|dc:26], @Check[fey-lore|dc:26], @Check[nature|dc:26], or @Check[stealth|dc:26] checks, they make the band and sergeant flee from a nonexistent fey attack. As for greed, if the PCs tempt them with 1,000 gp or more or succeed at three @Check[deception|dc:28], @Check[diplomacy|dc:28], or @Check[intimidation|dc:28] checks, the PCs can join as last-second recruits or get the troop and drill sergeant to leave. The successes between scaring and persuading the mercenaries can be counted together.

Impact on Infiltration: Take note that an alliance with the mercenaries is perilous and might make some complications more difficult during infiltration. That said, the mercenaries can help sow fear about the fey in Sarini Manor, making all troops @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} whenever they can observe a fey.

If any creatures from this encounter manage to flee, and the PCs didn't disguise themselves, the PCs gain 3 AP. On the other hand, if the PCs kept their identities concealed, most assume the mercenaries ran out of cowardice. Being detected but having no further interactions with this group has no impact, as the mercs think it was just a trick of the eye by fey magic. If the PCs replace or infiltrate the mercenaries, they gain 2 EP. Sending the mercenary band and sergeant away decreases the HP of all troop creatures at the manor by the level of the troop.

Reward: If the PCs resolve this encounter without combat, they receive full XP for it. Unlike Nixa and the Isgeri army, neither the mercenary band nor the drill sergeant can be recruited. They simply can't be trusted.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.36AlI54rphZ9eqEh]{Sergeant's Tent}
If the PCs Search the mercenary camp, they find a pouch that holds 600 gp in the sergeant's tent, including a note within mentioning these are the mercenary's wages.

Isgeri Infantry.name: Isgeri Infantry
Isgeri Infantry.text:
Isgeri InfantryModerate 8

Older and Wiser

Nixa and Nolaria are returnees from the Gallows of Madness Pathfinder adventure module, as are several NPCs in the Saringallow gazetteer. After what she went through, Nixa educated herself about outsiders such as fiends and fey, which helped her rise in the ranks in the army. She's popular among her soldiers for her down-to-earth nature, as many of them also come from rural regions of Isger.

The tents in the northern clearing are uniform and orderly, with guards regularly patrolling both within the camp as well as on the periphery. This group of Isgeri infantry is led by Nixa Volsetti (loyal female human captain 7), a soldier native to Saringallow. After 10 years in the military, Nixa has seen for herself how the army has failed the people of Isger time and again due to the ineptitude and willful inaction of the ruling elites, and she's desperate for reform. Whatever hope she had in Caeto's decisiveness quickly soured when he ordered the army to ignore the undead uprising. Her resentment only increased with the seizure of Saringallow and Caeto's willingness to work with fiends. Many of her soldiers share this sentiment and openly discuss their frustrations as they walk about the camp.

The PCs can easily overhear these conversations without a check while spying on the soldiers. Despite rumors of disgruntled fey, the soldiers don't care to keep their voices down, believing their captain Nixa knows tricks to pacify the fey if issues arise. A PC can attempt a @Check[isger-lore|dc:24|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] or @Check[society|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,skill,action:recall-knowledge|name:Recall Knowledge] check to Recall Knowledge to recognize Nixa's name as one of the youths caught up in the demon bile incident. It's possible they might have heard about her from conversations with residents in Saringallow, particularly her cousin Nolaria (see the @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22215saring]{Saringallow Gazetteer}).

Isgeri InfantryModerate 8

@UUID[Actor.iXtmj2696d1B7gBT]{Standard Bearers (2)} @UUID[Actor.AtaEH5txmra210Vv]{Isgeri Army Contingents (2)} @UUID[Actor.bV8bKtlNg0tDuDOa]{Nixa Volsetti}
