Creatures: Nixa's soldiers consist of two line infantries, each led by a standard bearer. During the day, Nixa walks out in the open among her soldiers. Past evening, she rests in her circular command tent. If the PCs attack the mercenaries without letting Nixa or her soldiers know, they assume it to be a drunken brawl until the mercenaries come to them for aid. The soldiers do their best to put themselves between Nixa and any enemies, though Nixa quickly moves up to Strike with her longsword against those who attack her soldiers. If any of her soldiers, singular or troop, fall below 25 Hit Points, Nixa surrenders since she doesn't want her soldiers killed. Her soldiers likewise surrender if Nixa is brought below 30 Hit Points, begging their captain to be spared.

If the PCs capture Nixa and her soldiers without agreeing to an alliance, they'll be held in Highfort. Nixa doesn't react well to this outcome, as Highfort is where she was kept prisoner during the demon bile incident in Gallows of Madness. If treated as captives, she and her army refuse to associate with the Hellbreakers afterward.

Sincere Alliance: As previously mentioned, Nixa doesn't like her standing orders. If the PCs reveal their intention to liberate Saringallow, she's inclined to assist by allowing them to pretend they're part of her troop. Likewise, if the PCs replace the mercenaries, Nixa would tell her soldiers to ignore what the PCs are up to if she learns of their reasoning.

If the PCs ask Nixa to take her army away, she can be persuaded with three successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:26], @Check[isger-lore|dc:26], or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:26] checks. If the PCs succeed, she sends Sephone an excuse about a nearby farm needing help with a sportlebore infestation. On failure, Nixa says she understands the PCs' desire, but she and her soldiers have orders and duties to fulfill. The party is still welcome to become "last-minute conscripts."

Impact on Infiltration: If Nixa and her army don't reach Sarini Manor and didn't send an explanation for their absence (or the PCs didn't fabricate one for her), the PCs gain 3 Awareness Points (AP) toward their infiltration. The same applies if the PCs fight but then retreat from this encounter. If Nixa and her army manage to detect and notice the PCs, but no combat nor further interaction took place, the PCs only gain 2 AP. Infiltrating the manor by replacing the Isgeri army grants the PCs 1 Edge Point (EP), while infiltrating the army grants the PCs 3 EP. Sending the troops away decreases the HP of all troop creatures at the manor by the level of the troop.

Reward: The PCs receive full XP for the encounter if they resolve it without combat. For PCs who form an alliance with Nixa or convinced her to leave, she and her soldiers return in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat]{Chapter 9}. While Nixa retains her statistics from this chapter, her soldiers become two @UUID[Actor.DxR0uu2PmLwxi7vA]{Heavy Cavalries}.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.OetQW36OmEbjukEz]{Nixa's Reward}
If the PCs ally with Nixa, she gives them a lesser reinforcing rune, two greater smoke balls, and a swift block cabochon. If the PCs need to disguise themselves as Isgeri infantry, she also has spare gear available.

Infiltration Day 1: An Ambush in the Dar.name: Infiltration Day 1: An Ambush in the Dark
Infiltration Day 1: An Ambush in the Dar.text:
Infiltration Day 1: An Ambush in the Dark

Awareness Points

Anytime the PCs roll a critical failure on a skill check during their infiltration, they gain 1 Awareness Point. If the roll was for a check under a complication entry, they gain 2 Awareness Points instead. The PCs can get a maximum of 25 Awareness Points. Upon reaching this threshold, infiltration immediately ends. The party is caught and thrown into the stables in the southwest corner of the manor grounds. Ethran arrives with some Hellbreakers (use the statistics of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.iYGdNF9BarBiJUJJ]{Line Infantry}) within the hour to free the PCs, after which they must deal with the security and researchers via combat.

 

Versatile Edge Points

While Edge Points are usually used to succeed at a failed roll against an obstacle or complication, for this chapter they can be expended to improve the result of any failed skill check to a success, providing the PC attempted the check while on Sarini Manor grounds and they're outside of combat.

Sarevial reveals there are two groups headed toward Sarini Manor who'll be camping near the ranch tonight: a unit of Isgeri infantry and a mercenary crew. Those at Sarini Manor likely haven't met these new hires yet, so if the PCs successfully infiltrate, intercept, or replace one or both of the groups, they can gain free access to the manor.

Working to take over the manor from within over a few days is unlikely to alert those in Saringallow that something is wrong at the manor, and being part of a larger group would also help the PCs blend in. The party will also need to keep Lifebloom out of sight since it's easily identifiable, though the other Wonders of the Seasons aren't known to the Hellknights.

Between replacing or infiltrating the group or bribing and recruiting them, Ethran thinks it's better for the Hellbreakers to choose the former because there's no risk of betrayal. The choice is ultimately left up to the party, and Ethran reminds the PCs that no matter what happens, they should use nonlethal force. Killing will give Caeto ammunition to paint the Hellbreakers as dangerous insurgents. For each non-fey creature the PCs kill in this chapter, they lose 1 Reputation Point unless stated otherwise.

Scene Notes Point Tracking

@UUID[Actor.yRfWWl75GVVgVrl7]{Infiltration Points Tracker}

Open Plans: The PCs have a lot of flexibility on how to handle the two groups, from their approach to how many enemies they want to take out. The two units are camped in clearings that are adjacent to each other, separated by a forest trail. Relations between the two groups are strained after several poor interactions between them on the trip from Elidir to Saringallow.

Whatever the plan is, the PCs should complete it within the next 24 hours, as the groups are scheduled to report to Sephone after this time passes. With a day to prepare and act, the PCs can spy on the groups to gather information and plan out their strategies. While they only need to replace or infiltrate one group, they should think of strategies to handle the other who might suspect something is wrong. Having a group dismissed is a boon in itself since it'll thin out the number of enemies during the secret takeover of Sarini Manor.

Vulaunex Ranch.name: Vulaunex Ranch
Vulaunex Ranch.text:
Vulaunex Ranch

After two days and nights of floating down the Clover Stream, Ethran takes the PCs to meet a rancher with a mild resemblance to Caeto. The man, Fierdo Vulaunex (grizzled male human rancher 3), is in fact Caeto's eldest brother. The ranch the PCs are hiding in is the Hellknight's childhood home, which he left and never visited again. His family isn't happy about the man Caeto has become, and while guilt is a motivator, Fierdo says the family is helping because the Hellbreakers are doing what's right.

Meeting Fierdo is an opportunity for the PCs to learn more about who Caeto was before he became a Hellknight. More details on Caeto's life can be found in his @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22216advent.JournalEntryPage.16campaignrole01]{NPC Entry}. The PCs' focus in this chapter remains on Sarini Manor otherwise.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.BR61dbzyTwujsC86]{Vulaunex Ranch}

Development: After the PCs settle down in one of the ranch's dormitories and learn how to disguise themselves in both appearance and vocabulary as ranch hands and rovers here for the upcoming calving season, Sarevial arrives on Quoster's cart, ready to pass the PCs and Ethran new intel so they can begin their infiltration. The infiltration of Sarini Manor uses the infiltration subsystem on pages 196–199 of GM Core.

Manor Matters.name: Manor Matters
Manor Matters.text:
Manor Matters

The PCs can attempt to Recall Knowledge with a DC 24 appropriate Lore or @Check[society|dc:24] check to know that Sarini Manor was once the home of the noble house of Sarini. The Sarinis were found guilty of kidnapping and murdering many of their own servants' children for fiendish sacrifices, and the noble family was subsequently lynched for their offense. Their surviving servants then founded Saringallow. The manor is also the source of the demon bile incident over a decade ago. While that corruption was cleared, no one has been back to inspect it.

Unfortunately, Jenvirick reports that after Saringallow was seized, Caeto allowed the diabolist Sephone Haugini (uptight female human diabolist 9) to claim the manor, reportedly for private research. As Sephone's mission is secondary, Caeto provided her with security that's sufficient but not impeccably tight. From Ethran's assessment, an infiltration might be possible, though the exact method is to be determined.

Ethran says they have a place close to the manor for the PCs to work from. A sympathetic rancher has expressed that he's willing to take the PCs in. If the PCs leave with Ethran by midnight (Pharast 10th going to 11th), they can get to the ranch by the early morning of the 12th. While the PCs undertake this mission, any Saringallow NPCs rescued will stay in Highfort to gather the army in secret.

Picking Up the Pieces.name: Picking Up the Pieces
Picking Up the Pieces.text:
Picking Up the Pieces

Ethran Howell arrives in the afternoon of the 10th of Pharast, heavily disguised as a wandering druid. A meeting is called, during which Ethran and Jenvirick share the following intel.

  • The day after Saringallow was seized, new forces moved in to secure the city. While most are loyal to Caeto, some Isgeri soldiers hold grudges over the inaction against the undead, a parallel to Isger's neglect of the countryside during the Goblinblood Wars.
  • A strict curfew has been enforced on Saringallow. Even merchants haven't been able to enter the city, and those at the docks have only been allowed to briefly resupply under the watchful eye of Caeto's forces.
  • The captured Hellbreakers are still alive. Ethran suspects Caeto intends to interrogate them for the location of those who escaped and the whereabouts of the warshard. Caeto is rumored to be leaving Saringallow on the 12th of Pharast to pick up a Chelaxian interrogator. Either the settlement of Misarias or Senara is his destination, meaning he'll likely be back in a week's time on the 19th. The Witchfire is being taken for the trip.
  • Saringallow's situation feels even bigger than Hellknight Hill; the Hellbreakers are going to need that army of theirs back if they want to reclaim the city.

Ethran and Jenvirick suggest that Caeto's week of absence is a good time to make some countermoves. Operating out of Highfort is difficult due to distance, so Ethran suggests the Hellbreakers secure the infamous Sarini Manor to be their main base. Only hours away from the city, the manor would be an excellent command post to lead the army from.

Desperate Escape.name: Desperate Escape
Desperate Escape.text:
Desperate EscapeChase 8

Escaping Caeto's forces is played out as a chase using the chase subsystem (GM Core 192). Each obstacle lasts 1 round, meaning the PCs can only attempt to overcome them once. The Penalty entry in each obstacle happens automatically. Many obstacles ask the PCs to make a hard choice and choose an NPC to rescue. While the captured NPCs will get roughed up, make it obvious that the enemies want to capture the Hellbreakers alive. Should a PC reach 0 Hit Points during the chase, they automatically stabilize, and the GM can assume any unconscious PCs are carried onto the next obstacle by a party member, NPC, or a sympathetic citizen.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.XlgeEFV3ECWEKctR]{Desperate Escape}

Hell On the DocksObstacle 8

Chase Points 1; Overcome @Check[acrobatics|dc:24] or @Check[athletics|dc:24] to quickly flee the ship, @Check[deception|dc:29] to convince the Hellknights there are no Hellbreakers at the docks, or @Check[stealth|dc:26|traits:secret,action:hide|name:Hide] to Hide

Hellknights sweep through the Saringallow docks, demanding to know which boat is the Witchfire. There isn't time to hoist the anchor and escape via river.

Penalty Cole and Rabbit are captured trying to distract the Hellknights away from the PCs.

Smoking BeaconObstacle 8

Chase Points 2; Overcome @Check[athletics|dc:29] to break open a window or door and let the smoke disperse, @Check[cooking-lore|dc:24] or @Check[crafting|dc:24] to throw food to distract the hell hounds, or @Check[perception|dc:26] or @Check[survival|dc:26] to navigate through the smoke

Hell hounds charge in and out of the Beacon Candles workshop, filling it with noxious smoke as Gram and Xerra help patrons escape.

Penalty The PCs take @Damage[5d6[fire]] damage from smoke inhalation. They can only rescue one Hellbreaker between Gram or Xerra; the other is captured by enemies.

Claws From the SkyObstacle 8

Chase Points 3; Overcome @Check[deception|dc:26] to distract the fiends, @Check[devil-lore|dc:24], @Check[fiend-lore|dc:24], or @Check[religion|dc:24] to repel the fiends, or @Check[intimidation|dc:29] to scare them into backing off

The Merchant's Square is overrun by a flying erinys targeting Maire and Rhokrag.

Penalty The PCs take @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage. They can only rescue one of the Hellbreakers here. The one they don't pick is grabbed by the erinys and captured.

Getaway VehicleObstacle 8

Chase Points 2; Overcome @Check[athletics|dc:29] to run ahead and push people to the side, @Check[diplomacy|dc:27] or @Check[intimidation|dc:26] to command the crowd, or @Check[driving-lore|dc:24] or @Check[nature|dc:24] to steer

A cart has been commandeered for a quick escape, but the streets are flooded with panicked crowds.

Penalty A Hellknight attempts to stop the cart. Either one of the rescued Hellbreakers sacrifices themself, or the PCs can body check the Hellknight. Choosing the latter results in the PCs taking @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage each and increases the next obstacle's DC by 1.

At the CrossroadsObstacle 8

Chase Points 3; Overcome @Check[arcana|dc:24] or @Check[occultism|dc:24] to interfere with the spellcasting, @Check[deception|dc:29] or @Check[stealth|dc:29] to obscure the Riotmongers' retreat, or @Check[intimidation|dc:26] to fluster the mages into making errors

In the Triangle Crossroads, battle mages bear down on the Riotmongers. Phoebe and Alceo both shout to save the other; a choice must be made.

Penalty The PCs fail to get to either of the Riotmongers, and both Alceo and Phoebe are captured.

Special If the PCs have rescued at least two Hellbreaker NPCs, two of the NPCs can sacrifice themselves to let the PCs get one Riotmonger to safety. The PCs are limited to one Riotmonger.

Gates Yet ClosedObstacle 8

Chase Points 1; Overcome @Check[athletics|dc:29] to lift the gate door, @Check[crafting|dc:24], @Check[engineering-lore|dc:24], or @Check[thievery|dc:24] to work the crank of the gate door, or @Check[driving-lore|dc:26] or @Check[nature|dc:26] to urge Quoster's horse to kick the gate open

Quoster drives the cart to Saringallow's barracks toward the closed and unmanned Noble Folly's gate.

Penalty The PCs are forced to leave Quoster's cart and use the wicket. The DC of the next obstacle increases by 2 as the party must escape on foot.

Hightail to HighfortObstacle 8

Chase Points 2; Overcome @Check[survival|dc:24] or @Check[nature|dc:26] or @Check[perception|dc:26] to locate a shortcut

The trek to Highfort is winding and confusing due to the chaos caused by enemies all around.

Penalty The PCs take longer to get to Highfort than expected, arriving there in 4 days instead of 2.

Special If there are Hellbreaker NPCs with the party, reduce the DC of this obstacle by 1 for each NPC.

Handling Loss

While the chase is meant to create a low point in the Adventure Path, GMs are free to modify the chase's penalties as necessary for their table, as not everyone might stomach losing so many NPCs in a single moment. The PCs might wish to sacrifice themselves during the chase, which the GM can accept at their discretion. As the adventure doesn't have room to cover the journey of any PCs who are captured, players should discuss with their GM on how best to handle the story going forward. The player can consider playing an NPC or a new character, so long as their level is appropriate.

Development: The Elidir Hellbreakers are relieved to see the PCs and any rescued NPCs arrive. Any PCs in need of medical attention are treated immediately. Currently, Highfort only knows that Saringallow has been seized and that all captured Hellbreakers seem to be alive. There are reports of forces scouring the rural areas for escapees, making travel high risk. No one has figured out how the headquarters was discovered and to what extent they've been exposed.

Jenvirick informs the PCs that she has sent for help, and the Eagle Knights are sending Ethran Howell to aid them. The Hellbreakers should take some mandatory downtime until they arrive. The PCs can use this downtime however they wish, so long as they remain in Highfort.

@UUID[Actor.0sw9xU4GP8ucdGG3]{Stipend}
The PCs receive 100 gp as a stipend toward equipment. As the city of Logas remains an ally, the PCs can access common items up to their level, though delivery might take time. Quoster can also attempt to obtain uncommon resources for them with a @Check[flat|dc:15] check.

Reward: The PCs receive 80 XP for completing the chase. If they escaped with four or more Hellbreaker NPCs free, they receive an additional 30 XP for the massive accomplishment. If a Riotmonger escaped, that Riotmonger grows more resolute, and the GM can add the elite template to the rescued Riotmonger from here on.

Day of Broken Bones.name: Day of Broken Bones
Day of Broken Bones.text:
Day of Broken Bones

The PCs are just returning to Saringallow when Cole Acton and “Rabbit” Dryden, two of the local Hellbreakers, run up in a panic when the PCs have properly docked.

“You've got to go!” Rabbit shouts, frantically looking backward. “They're looking for you! They've taken everyone! Hellknights—the Hellknights are here!”

Springing Sarini Manor.name: Springing Sarini Manor
Springing Sarini Manor.text:
Chapter 8: Springing Sarini Manor

Chapter Timeline

Below are the proposed dates of events and deadlines featured in this chapter. GMs are welcome to make adjustments. For this month, consider the impact of holidays, such as the vernal equinox.

 

Pharast 4726 ar

  • 5th: Day of Bones. Caeto commands a strike force to capture Saringallow and the Hellbreakers.
  • 6th: Reinforcements arrive to secure Saringallow. Sephone Haugini secures Sarini Manor.
  • 10th: Hellbreakers make plans to capture Sarini Manor. Excavations at Sarini Manor begin.
  • 11th: PCs leave Highfort for sympathetic ranch at midnight.
  • 12th: PCs arrive at Vulaunex Ranch in the early hours. Caeto leaves for Cheliax. Day 1 of infiltration.
  • 14th: Basement of Sarini Manor excavated. Sephone begins researching the excavated basement.
  • 16th: Sephone leaves the manor for 1 day to assist in the resurrection of Viro.
  • 18th: Proposed deadline for capturing Sarini Manor.
  • 19th: Date Caeto intended to return. He's delayed by a combination of bad luck and sabotage.
  • 20th: Vernal equinox. Day of Wrath in Cheliax.

In traveling throughout the country and bolstering the populace to join their rebellion, the Hellbreakers League has exposed itself—never have its members and leadership been so widely known. With many who joined the League eager to share stories of their contribution, there's bound to be an absent mind or slip of a tongue.

Aided by powerful friends, Caeto carefully tracked down the League's leadership to Saringallow. The fear of being watched seemed almost forgotten in the high of victory and the frenzy of returning to normalcy. Caeto allowed that complacency to grow, even fueling it by acting like he was cowed. In reality, the Hellknight was preparing a strike force, one pointed at the very heart of the rebel organization and waiting to stab.

Opportunity arrived on the sacred Day of Bones, a Pharasmin holiday where the community comes together to pay respects to the recent dead. As the first of such major holidays after the undead scourge, this Day of Bones is particularly significant, serving as a milestone in both resetting the pace of peace and acknowledging those who lost their lives. Though many were buried in their home settlements, the Hellbreakers agreed that honoring those who died shouldn't be bound by the whereabouts of the living, and the organization's leadership promised to observe the holiday together in Saringallow.

In this moment of vulnerability, Caeto's forces struck. At noon on the Day of Bones, when the Hellbreakers had agreed to assemble, Hellknights and Chelaxian forces seized Saringallow's entries and exits and searched for dissidents. On the top of their list were the Riotmongers and the PCs. As chaos descended in the town, a mile away on the Conerica River, the PCs are helping to upgrade the Witchfire for potential future battles and, as a result, are late in returning to Saringallow. The party doesn't realize it yet, but this tardiness is about to become one of the most fortuitous moments of their lives.

Concluding the Adventure.name: Concluding the Adventure
Concluding the Adventure.text:
Concluding the Adventure

Defeating Caeto, whether by knocking him unconscious, killing him, or accepting his surrender, results in his allies and forces surrendering immediately or fleeing. With the Hellknights no longer threatening the Hellbreakers' existence, the rebellion can finally operate out in public in peace. It's time to begin the long political road of fully extracting Isger from Cheliax's rule and establishing its new government.

In a gesture to walk away from the past, the Hellbreakers implore those who would join them to seek them out not in Elidir, but in Saringallow. For now, the PCs should savor their victory as the rays of a spring sun shine ever hopeful down upon the highlands between the Aspodell and Menador Mountains.

The Claws of Isger.name: The Claws of Isger
The Claws of Isger.text:
The Claws of IsgerSevere 9

After 15 minutes of tense discussion, Caeto signals for his troops to attack. He wants to end this revolution once and for all, and knows that the PCs are the face of it. Caeto's forces are at the northwestern part of the map, while the PCs are directly opposite. As the PCs fight Caeto, the other Hellbreakers engage with the bulk of Caeto's army just outside the square.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.QjnP6r0t65YN9sgH]{Skirmish}

This is a skirmish encounter, using the rules starting on page 158 of Battlecry! The objective of the encounter is to defeat Caeto or cause him to surrender; once this happens, Caeto's forces lay down their arms. However, if all the PCs are reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed, Caeto's forces run roughshod over the remainder of the Hellbreakers army.

The Claws of IsgerSevere 9

@UUID[Actor.mEPkM8E09ocOlWgF]{Aurocan} @UUID[Actor.wsDBwF7MedL37T7k]{Elite Coarti} @UUID[Actor.OlJumNUakoNVK9LK]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigades (2)} @UUID[Actor.Kt3LPIeQWWYzLuB3]{Hellknight Signifier} @UUID[Actor.MRmPouHx2mZiT4jm]{Caeto Vulaunex}

Creatures: Caeto commands one of the Hellknight cavalry brigades, while the signifer who accompanies him commands the other. He secured an intimidating-looking aurocan to bolster his forces, and the construct stomps through the PCs' troops when possible. An elite coarti is also part of Caeto's entourage; they fly above the combat and swoop down to strike at the most vulnerable.

The Gallows: Traveler's Square features an old gallows as a reminder of the city's bleak history (as marked on the map). It hasn't had a noose for years, and the platform shakes with each step taken on it. A troop can't occupy the same space as the gallows, but when a Large or smaller creature steps onto one of the two 5-foot-by-5-foot trapdoors, the entire structure falls apart. Each creature on the gallows falls 10 feet and takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save) from splintering wood. The space of the gallows then counts as difficult terrain.

PC Troops: The PCs command the same troops they led during Saringallow's liberation. Since a few days have passed, these troops are fully healed.

Scene Notes Macro

@UUID[Macro.zoFxDkxu49qkliEz]{Break Gallows}

Reward: For defeating Caeto at last, award the PCs 120 XP.

Dawn on the Horizon.name: Dawn on the Horizon
Dawn on the Horizon.text:
Dawn on the Horizon

Fighting One-on-One

At your discretion, Caeto can accept a demand from the PCs that they fight without involving any troops. The battle still takes place in Traveler's Square with the allies of both sides looking on. For an easier bout (though still a severe encounter), the PCs face Caeto and the elite coarti. For a more challenging fight (halfway between a severe and an extreme encounter), the PCs face Caeto and his Hellknight signifer ally.

The army marching with Caeto is small compared to the forces the PCs faced in retaking Saringallow. It enters the city through the northernmost gate on the western wall, passes the cemetery, and arrives in Traveler's Square. The Hellbreaker forces emerge from the woods to the west and from within the city to trap Caeto's army in a pincer. However, the fighting doesn't commence right away.

While Caeto is seething that the PCs have defeated his forces and reclaimed Saringallow, it also empowers him in a way, as it confirms for him the amount of damage the Hellbreakers can do when they fully disregard the law. If anything, he's more certain than ever that the rebels must be defeated. Caeto gives the PCs one last chance to defend themselves verbally. The PCs can flip the opportunity on Caeto to make him defend his own actions since they've met him.

This brief pause before the battle uses the influence subsystem (GM Core 187). The PCs have 3 rounds (each of which lasts about 5 minutes) to shake Caeto's confidence in his convictions.

Scene Notes Point Tracking Effect

@UUID[Item.6Wm5w0LXHEHPldtg]{Influence Points}

You can drag this effect onto Caeto's token to track influence points.

Caeto VulaunexCreature 11

  • Human
  • Humanoid

Self-righteous Hellknight Champion of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JndhOIHnQoMwnsw3]{The Godclaw}

Perception +18

Will +20 (+22 vs. mental)

Discovery @Check[chitterwood-lore|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[hellknight-lore|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:26|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[perception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover], @Check[society|dc:28|traits:concentrate,secret,action:discover|name:Discover]

Influence Skills @Check[legal-lore|dc:26|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:26|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] (to debate the merits of Isgeri self-rule), @Check[deception|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], @Check[diplomacy|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence], or @Check[intimidation|dc:28|traits:concentrate,linguistic,action:influence|name:Influence] (to shake Caeto's confidence)

Influence 2 Caeto's devotion isn't as fiery as it once was. The DC of his champion devotion spells is reduced by 2.

Influence 4 Caeto hesitates when combat begins. He's unable to use reactions for the first round of the fight.

Influence 6 The PCs rattle Caeto. He becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} when combat starts and is likely to surrender if he reaches 20 Hit Points or fewer.

Influence 8 The PCs undermine Caeto's very faith in himself. Caeto becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} when combat starts. He's likely to surrender if he reaches 40 Hit Points or fewer.

Resistances Caeto despises criminals and lawbreaking. Attempts to justify the Hellbreakers' unlawful actions increase influence DCs by 2.

Weaknesses The guilt of the decade where he thought nothing about Isger still eats away at Caeto. Any statements that point out how Caeto has forgotten his own past or is out of touch with Isger's current needs decrease the influence DC of the check by 2.

Background The twice-revived Hellknight of the Order of the Godclaw has large ambitions for himself and the law-abiding Isger he envisions.

Appearance Being put through the wringer has left some lines and dark circles on Caeto's face, though his eyes remain bright with misplaced conviction.

Personality Caeto can be charming when he wants to and vicious when he needs to.

Special If the PCs reveal to Caeto his forgotten connection with Sephone the diabolist, the Hellknight is so utterly shocked that he begins the ensuing combat as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Reward: If the PCs gain at least 4 Influence Points during this encounter, award them 10 XP. If they gain at least 6 Influence Points, award them 30 XP instead.

War Yet Won.name: War Yet Won
War Yet Won.text:
War Yet Won

Once the PCs have closed the portal at Crossroad Plaza, they can perform any rescue operations in the city they have yet to perform. Smaller battles continue to rage through the streets for the next couple of days, but the Hellbreaker army is ultimately victorious in freeing Saringallow.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.3N3iOqQ4I2grkiIk]{Post Battle Saringallow}

Afterward, celebrations commence throughout the city. During these festivities, the PCs get word that Caeto Vulaunex is on his way back to Saringallow with a large entourage. Scouts believe he will arrive on the 10th of Gozran, only 2 days from now. Depending on how efficiently the PCs liberated the city, Caeto might not be aware of the extent of the Hellbreakers' success. In any case, the PCs have an opportunity to ambush Caeto, stopping him from retaking Saringallow. The Riotmongers suggest that luring him into the city before springing the trap is likely the best bet, as the surrounding buildings give plenty of room to hide Hellbreaker forces. However, the 2 days are barely enough time to prepare. The PCs can perform any downtime activities they wish while the Hellbreakers and allied citizens of Saringallow establish facades to make it appear as if the Hellknights are still in control of the city.

The effectiveness of this ambush depends partially on the number of Liberation Points the PCs accumulated.

5 or fewer LP: Caeto isn't fooled by any deception and confidently walks into the trap. The DCs to Influence him increase by 1 and the PCs have 1 fewer round to attempt influence checks. In addition, he and all his allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative in the ensuing fight.

6 to 12 LP: Caeto is wary that something isn't right when his army approaches Saringallow. The PCs have 1 fewer round to attempt influence checks against him. In addition, he and all his allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative in the ensuing fight.

13 to 20 LP: The PCs can successfully spring the ambush on Caeto, but he didn't get to his position in the Hellknight by being a fool. No bonuses or penalties apply.

20 or more LP: Caeto is taken completely by surprise. The PCs have 1 additional round to attempt influence checks against him. In addition, he and all his allies take a –1 circumstance penalty to their initiative in the ensuing fight.

Reward: If the PCs gain at least 13 Liberation Points, award them 10 XP. If they gain at least 20 Liberation Points, award them 30 XP instead.

Mission 8: At a Crossroad.name: Mission 8: At a Crossroad
Mission 8: At a Crossroad.text:
Mission 8: At a CrossroadModerate 9

Within an hour of the PCs liberating the Temple of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.mm1j6UbHqFCI8fwB]{Erastil}, the occupying forces of Saringallow grow desperate. Some Hellknight signifers get together to perform a last-ditch summoning at Crossroad Plaza in the center of the city. These spellcasters are consumed in hellfire when the ritual goes awry, creating a semi-stable portal to Hell through which fiends begin to emerge. The PCs are immediately informed of the situation by a fellow Hellbreaker (or they might even witness a destructive plume of flame rise over the city rooftops) and must gather their troops to face whatever has come through.

This is a skirmish encounter, using the rules starting on page 158 of Battlecry! .. The objective of the encounter is to close the portal at the center of the plaza. An individual PC adjacent to the crater can attempt a @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[occultism|dc:28], or @Check[religion|dc:28] check as a two-action activity; a PC gains a +2 circumstance bonus to this check if they wield one of the Wonders of the Season. The PCs must succeed at three of these checks to fully close the portal.

PC Troops: The PCs take command of the troops with which they formed skirmish bonds before the attacks began. Though they've been fighting in the city all day, they haven't received any additional wounds from their skirmish outside the city walls. However, if this encounter takes place on a different day than the skirmish outside the city walls, the troops are fully healed. The PCs can approach the plaza from any direction they wish.

Mission 8: At a CrossroadModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.nrW641E6WhlSHWoo]{Hell Hound Pack (2)} @UUID[Actor.aiC8ah9tuwcW7jCD]{Greater Hell Hound} @UUID[Actor.PivErtrNesKLJZGf]{Ferrugon}

Creatures: The portal has already disgorged dozens of hell hounds, which have formed into two hell hound packs. They were followed by a single greater hell hound and a rust devil. While ferrugons usually prefer corrupting mortals to fighting them, this one is angry that it's been pulled through the portal to the mortal realm and begins smashing nearby structures. A few iron lampposts have been turned to rust when the PCs arrive. All these fiends fight until killed.

Scene Notes Macro

@UUID[Macro.MtnLWC7vgGPLuMq8]{Close Hell Portal}

Liberation Points: If the PCs fail to close the portal within 3 rounds, a group of flying devils escapes from it and disappears into the city. They lose 1 Liberation Point, and an additional Liberation Point for each additional round beyond the 3rd that the portal remains open.

Reward: For achieving this skirmish encounter's objective, award the PCs 80 XP.

Development: If any fiends remain on the field when the portal is closed, their essence is violently pulled into the closing rift, ending the encounter. A cheer goes up from the assembled troops, as the danger has now passed.

Mission 7: Stop that Pigeon!.name: Mission 7: Stop that Pigeon!
Mission 7: Stop that Pigeon!.text:
Mission 7: Stop that Pigeon!Low 9

As the PCs rush toward Saringallow's Sundries only a few blocks away from the temple, they can hear the continuing sounds of the battle at the western gates. The three-story-tall aviary attached to the building is easy to spot. Thirty feet in diameter, this tower has one continuous spiral staircase that runs along the wall from the ground floor to the top.

Mission 7: Stop that Pigeon!Low 9

@UUID[Actor.mAOIXlcM9KdmZObk]{Vordines (4)} @UUID[Actor.KN1JTYYyNrMWvLja]{Message Runner}

Creatures: Four vordines guard the base of the aviary stairs, while the message runner heads up to attach the note to a carrier pigeon. The length of the staircase to the top of the aviary is 100 feet. Catching a pigeon then takes an Interact action with a successful @Check[acrobatics|dc:22] check. Attaching the missive and throwing the pigeon out the window takes an Interact action each. The message runner does their best to remain on task, but engages any PCs that reach the same floor as them. Should the pigeon fly off, the PCs have until the beginning of the runner's next turn to take the poor bird out; a carrier pigeon has an AC of 15 and 7 Hit Points.

Development: If the pigeon manages to get away, Caeto learns about the attack on Saringallow and the PCs lose 4 Liberation Points.

Mission 6: Temple Rescue.name: Mission 6: Temple Rescue
Mission 6: Temple Rescue.text:
Mission 6: Temple RescueModerate 9

The main chamber of the temple would usually be filled with worshippers attending a sermon or the occasional devotee making a small offering to Old Deadeye. At the moment, most of the pews have been destroyed and much of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.mm1j6UbHqFCI8fwB]{Erastil} iconography has been defaced. Rooms past the main temple hold the most important prisoners of Saringallow's occupation.

Mission 6: Temple RescueModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.U4u3pSkDxGWLjJNd]{Fiendish Viro Ahala} @UUID[Actor.AnAgh2rj4z4aZ9hH]{Nayren Allurajix}

Creatures: With Caeto out of the city, Nayren Allurajix oversees the occupation from here. The recently revived and now fiendish Viro is also at the temple, hoping to have a final showdown with the PCs. While the two have not known each other for long, they work seamlessly, flanking to take down opponents, covering each other's back. Nayren fights until they fall below 20 Hit Points. They know that if they're killed, Caeto is going to be in danger, so they attempt to flee. Viro, on the other hand, fights to the death, as he just doesn't know when to quit his vengeance.

Liberation Points: By freeing any captured Riotmongers and Ildris, the PCs gain 3 Liberation Points. If Nayren manages to escape, they have a chance to warn Caeto personally, and the PCs lose 2 Liberation Points.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.pnfiy3UJTQ5IDpun]{Ildris' Gift} @UUID[Actor.iLXQI1C5xP7jKNZP]{Riotmongers' Reward}
Ildris gifts the PCs a greater staff of protection, a potion of flying, and a potion of quickness in gratitude. The Riotmongers retrieve the greater symbol of conflict recovered from Illcayna's warshard in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq]{Chapter 7} and give it to the PCs.

Development: Either from one of the freed prisoners or from Nayren's dying breath (if they're killed), the PCs discover that the Hellknight sent a missive to the aviary atop Saringallow's Sundries addressed to Caeto right before the PCs arrived at the temple. If Caeto hears about the siege of the city, he might be able to prepare for a counterattack upon his return, possibly even bringing more troops with him. The PCs are advised to race to the aviary to stop that message (see Mission 7)!

Before they go, Ildris can offer two PCs a blessing of Erastil that heals them, restoring @Damage[5d8+40[[healing]] Hit Points each.

Mission 5: Temple Entrance.name: Mission 5: Temple Entrance
Mission 5: Temple Entrance.text:
Mission 5: Temple EntranceModerate 9

The entrance to the city's Temple of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.mm1j6UbHqFCI8fwB]{Erastil} faces Saringallow's massive graveyard. In better times, the building was visited by dozens of people daily, seeking blessings, medical attention, or emergency housing. Now, it serves as a makeshift prison for the former head priest Ildris Ruvarra. As such, it is well-guarded, and the PCs have to fight through the force stationed on the steps (at the only entrance) if they want to rescue those inside.

Mission 5: Temple EntranceModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.ACJysHhn1MHc97IQ]{Sarglagons (3)}

Creatures: A trio of sarglagons have been called to watch over the street in front of the temple. They're upset about the lack of water here and would rather be down near the docks. Also, they've been forbidden to join the fighting at the gates to the west; the sounds of that close battle are driving them to distraction. They don't notice the PCs approach, but fight until destroyed when the heroes get too close.

Development: Once the PCs have defeated the sarglagons, they can proceed inside to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission6temp00]{Mission 6}.

Mission 4: Headquarters Rescue.name: Mission 4: Headquarters Rescue
Mission 4: Headquarters Rescue.text:
Mission 4: Headquarters RescueModerate 9

After some consideration, Caeto decided the Hellbreakers' elusive headquarters would make the perfect bait for capturing those who got away. He therefore imprisoned more important Hellbreakers NPCs of 3rd level, such as Gram, Rhokrag, and Maire, in the rooms on the second floor. If there are no captured NPCs that fit that description, there are three generic senior Hellbreakers here instead.

Mission 4: Headquarters RescueModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.XMqHEK3GnTe2CoYR]{Assassins (3)}

Creatures: Three assassins await on the first floor, hidden in the banisters above the dining room. Due to their contract, the assassins are obligated to fight to the death, though they do their best to knock the PCs unconscious instead of killing them.

Liberation Points: Freeing the Hellbreakers here grants the PCs 1 Liberation Point.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.ZmsE34LVsFXG371J]{Captives' Reward}
The Hellbreaker captives give the PCs a basilisk eye, trident of lightning, and nettleweed residue.

Development: The Hellbreakers here aren't sure where any captured Riotmongers are being kept within the city, but one of them overheard a soldier mentioning that Nayren Allurajix, the Hellknight currently in charge of the city, has been spending a lot of time near the Temple of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.mm1j6UbHqFCI8fwB]{Erastil} since imprisoning Ildris Ruvarra. Both he and the Riotmongers might be kept somewhere in the temple. At the very least, someone stationed at the temple might be able to give the PCs the information they want. This points the PCs to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission5temp00]{Mission 5} if they don't already know about it.

Mission 3: Workshop Rescue.name: Mission 3: Workshop Rescue
Mission 3: Workshop Rescue.text:
Mission 3: Workshop RescueLow 9

From their research or other means, the PCs have learned that some of their Hellbreaker allies are being kept in the Beacon Candle workshop. The Hellbreaker siege feint means that most of the security there has been redirected elsewhere, giving the PCs an opportunity to free the prisoners.

Mission 3: Workshop RescueLow 9

@UUID[Actor.bB0xa94FH7s9r70p]{Coarti} @UUID[Actor.aiC8ah9tuwcW7jCD]{Greater Hell Hound}

Creatures: The enemy forces have left a greater hell hound and a coarti behind to guard the building. The hell hound patrols the warehouse area (55 feet by 60 feet) alone, making chew toys out of the workshop's furniture. The coarti watches the shopfront (35 feet by 20 feet), which opens directly to the outdoors and warehouse. Both creatures fight until destroyed.

Captured Hellbreakers NPCs of level 2 and lower are imprisoned here. If no NPCs captured fit that bill, there are five generic members of the Hellbreakers League imprisoned here.

Liberation Points: Saving these Hellbreakers grants the PCs 1 Liberation Point.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.z56TwHI6nw21OXXK]{Workshop}
Stashed away among the workshop's stock are three standard-grade alloy orbs and a moderate bravo's brew.

Development: If the PCs haven't learned the locations of the other Hellbreaker prisoners, one of the NPCs here tells the PCs about those being held in the former HQ (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission4head00]{Mission 4}).

Mission 2: Armory Sabotage.name: Mission 2: Armory Sabotage
Mission 2: Armory Sabotage.text:
Mission 2: Armory SabotageModerate 9

Saringallow's town hall complex is close to the center of the city. Most of the buildings are administrative, but the area also includes a small garrison and armory for the city's guards. Since Saringallow's occupation, this area has been overrun by Hellknights and devils as Caeto and Nayren work to keep their forces supplied. A calculated strike against the armory while most of the occupying forces are fighting at the western wall would help undermine their strength and make the liberation of Saringallow that much easier.

Once inside the city proper, the PCs can approach the town hall garrison from almost any direction. When they arrive, they find it nearly empty. The mayor and other bureaucrats are still within, hunkering down as the siege commences, but even if they spot the PCs approaching, they don't try to stop them.

To sabotage or destroy the armory, the PCs can use any means at their disposal, whether that be with devastating spells, using demolition equipment, or by smashing and stealing everything in sight. That last method takes about an hour.

You can use part of Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Bigger Keep for this encounter.

Mission 2: Armory SabotageModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.HTb9mNysfUL91Jc7]{Levaloch} @UUID[Actor.M21ZwopspJTZ4LE6]{Drill Sergeants (2)}

Creatures: Before the PCs can examine the garrison armory, they have to deal with the few individuals left behind: a pair of Hellknight drill sergeants and a warmonger devil called to keep watch over the building. The devil fights until destroyed, but the drill sergeants flee the scene when reduced to 20 or fewer Hit Points.

Liberation Points: For destroying the garrison armory, the PCs gain 2 Liberation Points.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.J6jzc03gEx8E3TFS]{Armory}
Within the armory, the PCs find a runestone with a coating rune.

Mission 1: Noble's Folly Gate.name: Mission 1: Noble's Folly Gate
Mission 1: Noble's Folly Gate.text:
Mission 1: Noble's Folly GateModerate 9

The feint against the western gates does draw most of the city's attention there, but as the PCs might have learned, the Hellknight signifer Gredress Tilnanos isn't easily fooled. Her paranoia pays off when she spots the PCs marching on Noble's Folly Gate. To begin their infiltration of the city, the PCs will have to take the gatehouse where Gredress is holed up. They must do so alone, as the troops they brought to the city remain in the field to battle the Hellknight brigades. To represent the interior of the gatehouse, use an appropriate Flip-Mat of your choice.

Mission 1: Noble's Folly GateModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.URs26M6HcKotZfUB]{Gredress Tilnanos} @UUID[Actor.HTb9mNysfUL91Jc7]{Levalochs (3)}

Creatures: Gredress has three warmonger devils with her to protect the gatehouse. They protect her as frontline fighters while she casts spells at the PCs. These foes fight to the death or until unconscious, not realizing how powerful the PCs are.

Liberation Points: Defeating Gredress and securing the gate earns the PCs 2 Liberation Points.

Development: If the PCs haven't learned about where the Hellknights are keeping Hellbreakers captive yet, a note in the gatehouse informs them about the prisoners being held at the Beacon Candle workshop (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission3work00]{Mission 3}).

Missions Inside Saringallow.name: Missions Inside Saringallow
Missions Inside Saringallow.text:
Missions Inside Saringallow

Once the PCs have made it inside the Noble's Folly gatehouse, their journey to liberate Saringallow begins in earnest. They must first defeat those occupying the gatehouse to allow their troops inside the city, but after that, they can complete most of the missions below in any order. Some missions will lead to others, and the PCs might only know about certain missions if they completed enough research (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09recon000000000]{Saringallow Reconnaissance}).

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.r7WnL8BtD9jv3SNw]{Battle for Saringallow}

Outside the Walls.name: Outside the Walls
Outside the Walls.text:
Outside the WallsModerate 9

Though most of the Hellknight troops have shifted their focus to the western walls, the PCs have to deal with one patrolling army before they can reach Noble's Folly Gate. This entails taking the troops they're commanding and smashing through the line to reach the gatehouse entrance.

This is a skirmish encounter, using the rules outlined starting on page 158 of Battlecry! The objective of the encounter is for all PCs to reach the gatehouse entrance (as indicated by the dotted lines on the map). For more than one PC to enter that space, the PCs will have to relinquish command of their troops at just the right moment, leaving them vulnerable to being routed. However, once all PCs are in the designated area, they can move on to @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission1nobl00]{Mission 1} while their troops finish the battle outside the gate. If the half of the PCs' troops are routed before they can enter the gatehouse, the PCs will have to either flee and try again with different troops or finish the fight.

PC Troops: The PCs command the troops they chose to form a skirmish bond with before the siege begins (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09strategyandl00]{Strategy and Logistics}).

Outside the WallsModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.HXV6fu3Zp4MCquQ8]{Hellknight Field-maralictors (2)} @UUID[Actor.rxHbSWGMlUEwDgtN]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigades (2)} @UUID[Actor.gHdEUISFGR2vQIkQ]{Besunas} @UUID[Actor.shE80MSMMEp1O9Ci]{Vordine Legion}

Creatures: The patrol consists of two Hellknight cavalry brigades, each led by a Hellknight field-maralictor. They are accompanied by a legion of vordines commanded reluctantly by an experienced docent devil named Besunas. The docent devil hopes that the throng of vordines will protect her while she casts her spells, and only drives them forward into melee combat when left with no other choice.

Reward: For achieving this skirmish encounter's objective, award the PCs 80 XP.

Development: Keep track of how much damage the PCs' troops take in this fight. Unless the PCs take the time now to provide healing for their troops, these soldiers will be wounded when they rejoin the PCs for the fight in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission8atac00]{Mission 8} if it occurs on the same day as this fight.

The Western Feint.name: The Western Feint
The Western Feint.text:
The Western Feint

With advice from Ethran (and Rhokrag if he hasn't been captured again), the Hellbreakers have a plan that will distract most of the occupying forces long enough for the PCs to take their own troops and infiltrate the city. Several of the armies the PCs have recruited over the past few weeks will march on Saringallow's two western gates with the seeming intent of breaking through. This should draw enough Hellknights and devils to that side of the city, allowing the PCs to take Noble's Folly Gate to the north. This won't be simple, however, as the Hellknights have armies to spare!

The strength of the forces sent to this feint will determine its success. The players should choose six troops from the troops they have recruited (three for each gate). They shouldn't choose any of the troops they've already formed a skirmish bond with; those soldiers will be accompanying the PCs as they march on the northern gate. Then, add up the levels of the three troops assigned to each gate. If the PCs assign an NPC commander to a group of three, add 1 to that total. If the total for a group is 15 or lower, the PCs earn 1 Liberation Point. Otherwise, they earn 2 Liberation Points. The PCs can earn a total of 4 Liberation Points for this feint.

When these armies attack the western gates, the PCs can proceed to Noble's Folly Gate, starting with a skirmish outside the walls (see below).

Liberation Points.name: Liberation Points
Liberation Points.text:
Liberation Points

The success of the retaking of Saringallow is measured in Liberation Points. The PCs might already have gained a few Liberation Points from earlier actions, but the majority of Liberation Points will be garnered through their efforts on the field of battle and within the city walls. Keep a running tally of the total Liberation Points, as this will also determine how quickly Caeto Vulaunex learns that the Hellbreakers have retaken the city.

Scene Notes Point Tracking

@UUID[Actor.wMEcyJkazdyaOM8Y]{Liberation Points Tracker}

Momentum is important. Once the attacks begin, if the PCs retreat from the city to take a full night's rest, they lose 2 Liberation Points, plus 1 additional Liberation Point for every day they don't resume the attack, as the Hellknight forces use the respite to bolster their defenses.

However, in between their missions, the PCs can bolster the attacking forces with the Aid Liberation exploration activity.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.QjnP6r0t65YN9sgH]{Skirmish}

Aid Liberation

  • Exploration

You briefly deviate from your planned missions to find a spot where your allies could use some help, either defeating an evenly matched force or planning a route to proceed through the city. This takes 10 minutes. Attempt a @Check[warfare-lore|dc:28] check.

Critical Success Through your words or your deeds, you give an allied troop much-needed tactical advice or help them vanquish a foe. You gain 2 Liberation Points.

Success You lend a hand to an allied troop in battle. You gain 1 LP.

Failure As you fight your way through the streets, you have an unplanned skirmish. You handily win the fight, but each PC loses a number of Hit Points equal to their level.

Critical Failure You make a tactical blunder, engaging an enemy you weren't prepared for. You lose 1 LP, and each PC loses a number of Hit Points equal to twice their level.

Special Once a PC performs this exploration activity, no other PC can attempt it until the PCs have gained or lost Liberation Points through another means.

For Saringallow!.name: For Saringallow!
For Saringallow!.text:
For Saringallow!

On the morning of the 5th of Gozran, the temporary Hellbreaker leadership calls upon the PCs. Ethran gives each PC a standard bearing the Hellbreakers' insignia, which officially puts them in charge of leading this battle. The PCs can easily notice that no other Hellbreaker, not even a Riotmonger, is holding a standard. The PCs have truly been given the reins of command for the upcoming battle to free the city. The Eagle Knight muses how less than a year ago, the PCs were but recruits running errands. They've since grown into capable leaders with more than a hundred under their command. It's a heavy burden, but one that the PCs wear well.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.4XmonOCf59drkjib]{Assembled Army}

Speech! Speech! The gathered army clamors for the PCs to say something encouraging. This monumental moment requires each PC to attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:26], @Check[intimidation|dc:26], or @Check[performance|dc:26] check. If they achieve at least one success, the army erupts into rousing cheers. For the remainder of the chapter, each troop commanded by a PC can reroll a single check during the first skirmish encounter they are part of; this is a fortune effect. If the PCs achieved at least three successes, each troop commanded by a PC gains this benefit for all skirmish encounters they are part of.

Counterspy.name: Counterspy
Counterspy.text:
CounterspyModerate 9

Espionage is a common tactic in warfare, especially during revolutions and protracted sieges. While the PCs are doing their own reconnaissance, the Hellknight forces stationed in Saringallow are on the watch for them. Their interim leader Nayren Allurajix is expecting the Hellbreakers League to try to rescue their captive comrades, so the Hellknight is on guard for the rebels' approach. To that end, as the PCs continue to amass their forces by Sarini Manor and perform their own spying, a group of devils is watching them.

When the PCs accrue 8 Research Points in the Saringallow Reconnaissance research challenge above, an allied lookout catches a glimpse of one these devils near the manor late one night. Alternatively, you can use this encounter at any time before the Hellbreakers' attack on the city begins to show that their enemies aren't complacently waiting around.

This encounter can take place on any map used to represent the lands near Sarini Manor. It's nighttime, but the lookout drops their lit lantern after spotting the devil, providing some light to see by.

CounterspyModerate 9

@UUID[Actor.uvoYRz3a0xwTKxoc]{Coarti Spies (4)}

Creatures: While the lookout spotted only one devil, the counterespionage unit consists of four coartis, using their wings and their ability to teleport to remain out of sight until now. They descend upon the lookout, who cries out for help before they're swarmed. While the PCs don't have enough time to muster any of their allied troops, they can arrive on the scene before the coartis escape. The devils take this opportunity to engage in battle instead of fleeing, either mistakenly believing the PCs will be as easy to kill or recognizing them as important Hellbreaker leaders.

One coarti casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} at the beginning of the fight to prevent allied NPCs at the manor from interfering. Two of the devils stand firm against the PCs, using Despairing Shriek if the other coartis aren't in range. The other two swoop in to strike before flying out of melee range each turn. The coartis fight until defeated.

Sabotage.name: Sabotage
Sabotage.text:
Sabotage

A city under siege is at the mercy of its current level of supplies and an ever-shrinking morale. While most of the occupiers of Saringallow are devils and highly disciplined Hellknights, the PCs can nevertheless attempt to sabotage the city's defenses in preparation for their eventual attack using the Sabotage Saringallow downtime activity described below. This activity takes 8 hours (and so precludes any other downtime activities) and grants @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09liberationpo00]{Liberation Points}. The PCs can earn a maximum of 5 Liberation Points from sabotage.

Sabotage Saringallow

  • Downtime

Through espionage and similar underhanded tactics, you weaken the occupying Hellknights' defenses and morale. Attempt a @Check[deception|dc:26], @Check[thievery|dc:26], or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:26] check.

Critical Success You cut off external supplies or sow chaos in the city from afar. You gain 1 Liberation Point and the next check attempted to Sabotage Saringallow gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

Success You manage to noticeably sabotage an aspect or function of the city. You gain 1 LP.

Critical Failure Your efforts backfire, causing the occupying forces to dig in. You lose 1 LP (minimum of 0).

Strategy and Logistics.name: Strategy and Logistics
Strategy and Logistics.text:
Strategy and Logistics

By this point, the Hellbreakers have multiple armies under their banner. The PCs have already engaged in a bit of skirmish warfare, but the upcoming siege on Saringallow will see them fully implementing their troops to their full abilities against other large troops. How the PCs direct the troops under their command will affect the overall outcome of the battle.

As such, the PCs should choose four troops with which to gain skirmish bonds. Each PC forms a skirmish bond with one troop, and that bond will be active for the entirety of the siege. Should a PC's troop be killed in the line of duty, they can command a new troop of the same level in the next skirmish encounter, but unless the PCs retreat from the city and take an entire day of downtime to train with their troops, that PC doesn't have a skirmish bond with this new troop. The ramifications of stepping away from the battle for a day are explained in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09liberationpo00]{Liberation Points}.

The PCs choose two level 8 troops and two level 9 troops for the battles ahead. No matter who else they've recruited, the level 8 troops available to them include an @UUID[Actor.Fkxpe6jybXe6Kt71]{Elite Bandit Gang}, an @UUID[Actor.JDPnJ5N71bbBz2Je]{Elite Gnome Cannon Corps}, a @UUID[Actor.kQJn4brkv7PGDfwm]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigade}, and a troop of @UUID[Actor.eCPHkPYuKLhBSyaT]{Woodland Scouts}. Similarly, the level 9 troops include a @UUID[Actor.v7WSuBOGVmlAuFEX]{Hobgoblin Veteran Regiment}, a @UUID[Actor.wXKSL6ZfiVoKPxFG]{Mercenary Band}, a @UUID[Actor.HPcDDbKDiVS3OWOw]{Weak Dwarf Longshot Squad}, and a @UUID[Actor.bP1uS10UfxWjZjt1]{Weak Watchmage Squadron}. You can provide the PCs with other options at your discretion.

The lower-level troops the PCs have been recruiting will also be helpful in the war effort, as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09thewesternfe00]{The Western Feint}.

Recon.name: Recon
Recon.text:
Recon

Other Strategies

Your PCs might have a different idea about infiltrating Saringallow, and that's fine! Ethran or another Hellbreaker can steer them toward the methods presented in this chapter, but ultimately, the players are in charge of the liberation. Use the missions and Liberation Points rules provided to adjudicate their method, and be sure to stress the importance of rescuing captives and taking out key enemy figures like Gredress Tilnanos and Nayren Allurajix.

Using stealth, deception, and perhaps a bit of magic, the PCs can investigate occupied Saringallow to discover any weak points in its defenses and discover where their comrades are being held. They might also receive a bit of insight on who or what they'll likely face when they storm the walls.

This investigation uses the Research subsystem (GM Core 190). Each research check takes 8 hours, so any PC who attempts one won't be able to do downtime activities that day. The PCs can use the following methods to gain reconnaissance on Saringallow. At the GM's discretion, the use of an appropriate spell (such as a scrying spell to look into the city from a distance) gains the PCs 1 or more Research Points.

Questioning the Locals: The PCs can make inquiries about what's been going on behind the walls by speaking with the citizens who are allowed to come and go and those who live just outside the city;
Maximum RP 5;
Research Checks @Check[isger-lore|dc:24] or @Check[society|dc:24] to determine which people to approach, @Check[diplomacy|dc:26|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to win the citizens over, @Check[intimidation|dc:27|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to scare the locals into divulging information.

Spying on the City: Reconnaissance from afar is the best way to learn about Saringallow's current situation without being spotted;
Maximum RP 5;
Research Checks @Check[engineering-lore|dc:23] or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:23] to notice weak spots in the city's defenses, @Check[stealth|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to observe unnoticed, @Check[perception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[society|dc:26|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to follow enemy movements within the city.

Trading Secret Messages: The Hellbreakers League had lots of allies within Saringallow, and those who haven't been captured might be able to get information to the PCs if contacted;
Maximum RP 5;
Research Checks @Check[scribing-lore|dc:22|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to hide requests in the margins of normal documents, @Check[society|dc:24|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to encode and decode messages, @Check[deception|dc:26|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] or @Check[stealth|dc:26|traits:concentrate,exploration,linguistic,action:Research|name:Research] to keep the correspondence secret.

Scene Notes Point Tracking

@UUID[Actor.xNd1k6PvXXUpGf3H]{Research Points Tracker}

Saringallow ReconnaissanceResearch 9

  • Unique

Research Checks questioning the locals, spying on the city, trading secret messages

1 Research Point Before he left Saringallow, Caeto handed the reins of command to Nayren Allurajix (confident agender human battleblooded nephilim Hellknight), a maralictor from the Order of the Rack. Nayren would likely keep watch over important prisoners.

3 Research Points Most of the devil summoning is overseen by a gate-maralictor named Gredress Tilnanos (cautious female human Hellknight signifer 7). Gredress is the most perceptive of the leaders and won't be easily fooled by feints. However, if she can be eliminated, devil reinforcements will be limited. The PCs learn about how the Hellknight forces have been stockpiling weapons in City Hall's attached armory (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission2armo00]{Mission 2}). A Hellbreaker ally delivers 6 silver salves to the PCs. @UUID[Actor.yjwUTV45qpaXTN46]{Hellbreaker Ally's Gift}

5 Research Points The PCs learn that the two city gates closest to Saringallow's graveyard appear to be the least defended, but this is likely a ploy to ensnare attacking armies. The PCs can take advantage of this by feinting toward those gates with a sizable army while sending a smaller force to infiltrate via the Noble's Folly Gate (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission1nobl00]{Mission 1}).

8 Research Points There's a Hellknight among the enemy forces who has been resurrected recently. Reportedly, there were some complications that required heavy negotiations with Hell. The PCs also learn that Hellbreakers property has been conveniently converted to makeshift prisons (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission3work00]{Mission 3}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission4head00]{Mission 4}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09mission5temp00]{Mission 5}). No matter how secretive they've been, the PCs have to deal with an enemy spying on them (see @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat.JournalEntryPage.09counterspyun00]{Counterspy})!

12 Research Points The Hellknight occupiers likely won't hold back if the PCs manage to free a Riotmonger. Other than the words “dragon” and “undead,” no other information has been provided.

15 Research Points The revived Hellknight is Viro Ahala, transformed into a being of hellish rage as both punishment and reward. The PCs should be prepared to face the armiger once again alongside Nayren. An ally gives the PCs a moderate reinforcing rune. @UUID[Actor.E4tQyxemezHsIS5Z]{Hellbreaker Ally's Gift}

Reward: If the PCs gain at least 5 Research Points, award them 10 XP. If they gain all 15 Research Points, award them 30 XP instead.

Preparing for War.name: Preparing for War
Preparing for War.text:
Preparing for War

For the next several days, the PCs should make preparations for the battle ahead. Saringallow isn't an easy target to besiege, but that doesn't mean it's impossible. Perhaps there's a weakness or two the PCs can exploit if they wish to infiltrate the city instead. The PCs should also take a day to form a skirmish bond with one of the recruited troops, preferably one of 8th or 9th level; they won't always be fighting alongside this troop, but once the siege begins, they won't have time to form this bond, so they should do it now. The PCs can also take the time to craft items and retrain, if they so desire.

The Calm Before the Storm.name: The Calm Before the Storm
The Calm Before the Storm.text:
The Calm Before the Storm

The adventure returns to a slight sandbox again from the 21st of Pharast to the 4th of Gozran. During this time, while the army continues to come together, the party can head out again and attempt to recruit any troops they didn't manage to unlock in the previous two chapters. They can recruit up until the 31st, as it's suggested the 1st to 4th of Gozran be used for the armies to train and strategize together.

The Hellbreaker Coalition

Below is a list of all the troops and NPCs (in bold) the PCs might have conscripted since @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22207wightq]{Chapter 7} or can newly conscript this chapter, in order of the level of the unit from lowest to highest. Ancestry adjustments (NPC Core 168) that might be applicable are also noted. An asterisk indicates that the PCs should automatically receive these troops at the beginning of @UUID[JournalEntry.pf2ap22209thebat]{Chapter 9}.

  • Stumpfield: @UUID[Actor.MwOlQdz8hOfc87hj]{Line Infantry} (goblin), @UUID[Actor.nJYsrUzjV36Zm1Sq]{Stumpfield War Saboteurs}, @UUID[Actor.nJYsrUzjV36Zm1Sq]{Stumpfield War Saboteurs}
  • Umok: @UUID[Actor.MwOlQdz8hOfc87hj]{Line Infantry} (gnome), @UUID[Actor.tsPJac8BQe8I5OAu]{Wolf Pack}, @UUID[Actor.QBSYTqE0ZPotsntH]{Umok Beastspeaker Circle}
  • Vordia: @UUID[Actor.MwOlQdz8hOfc87hj]{Line Infantry}, @UUID[Actor.8eHHnGi5anARfz78]{Dwarf Battalion}, @UUID[Actor.JDPnJ5N71bbBz2Je]{Gnome Cannon Corps}
  • Wolfpoint: @UUID[Actor.MwOlQdz8hOfc87hj]{Line Infantry}, @UUID[Actor.Mcq1hhEBMby16QVy]{Goblin Get Gang}, @UUID[Actor.Fkxpe6jybXe6Kt71]{Bandit Gang}
  • Thorngrip: 2 @UUID[Actor.lq3y8VEfvHfdSamq]{Elite Goblin Rabbles}*, @UUID[Actor.HGyO6k5SYD8Mk4Ms]{Brakknap}, @UUID[Actor.CtBBPQ2rGt8ufHEn]{Hobgoblin Battalion}*
  • Gillamoor, A1: 1 or 2 @UUID[Actor.kQJn4brkv7PGDfwm]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigade(s)}
  • Logas: 2 @UUID[Actor.CtBBPQ2rGt8ufHEn]{Hobgoblin Battalions}*
  • Chapter 8 Chase: @UUID[Actor.q0XepvHOPbKUBmQw]{Alceo Demetrias} or @UUID[Actor.El5NbGq15XeN0tfC]{Phoebe Demetrias}
  • Ambush Site, E1: @UUID[Actor.bV8bKtlNg0tDuDOa]{Nixa Volsetti}, 2 @UUID[Actor.DxR0uu2PmLwxi7vA]{Heavy Cavalries}
  • Sarini Manor: @UUID[Actor.TmPm2xMRqqXORKWy]{Spring's Crown}, @UUID[Actor.XVPfEuyvZJ952Hda]{Weak Redcap Brigade}
  • Oprak: If Ambassador Vrig is alive, the PCs can attempt to recruit a @UUID[Actor.CtBBPQ2rGt8ufHEn]{Hobgoblin Battalion} as a basic unit and a @UUID[Actor.v7WSuBOGVmlAuFEX]{Hobgoblin Veteran Regiment} as an advance unit from Oprak.

Skirmish at the Ranch.name: Skirmish at the Ranch
Skirmish at the Ranch.text:
Skirmish at the RanchLow 9

One of the strategic advantages of the ranch is that one side of it is higher in elevation than the other. The road leading to the entrance of the ranch was dug right into the hill that creates that height difference, meaning there's a 5-foot overhang on each side. Currently, the entire land is bathed in darkness save for the festival site, which is well lit with torches and a giant bonfire. Near the center of the ranch, there's a small artificial pond that's 5 feet deep.

Scene Notes Ambience

@UUID[Playlist.xFxoBJfTP2d2zmNB.PlaylistSound.QjnP6r0t65YN9sgH]{Skirmish}

This is a skirmish encounter that uses the rules starting on page 158 of Battlecry! The objective of the encounter is to rout the two Hellknight cavalry brigades. This will be easier if their commanders are defeated or flee. If half of the PCs are knocked unconscious, the Hellknights have free rein to tear the ranch apart.

PC Troops: Given the urgency of the situation, the PCs must rely on the troops readily available at the ranch. They have four troops—two @UUID[Actor.WOOlg7muNLzievoP]{Line Infantries} and two @UUID[Actor.ANoT7Qfx5hPxEDRp]{Phalanx Formations}—ready to fight, but the PCs don't have time to form skirmish bonds with them. Since they know the enemies are coming in advance, the party can decide where they and their troops start.

Creatures: Two groups are pursuing Nolaria. One consists of 2 Hellknight cavalry brigades, each led by a Chelaxian knight. The second group is actually Saringallow's own city guard led by Captain Jordis, who volunteered to join the search. While they put on a grand display of pretending to be loyal to be Cheliax, the captain and the guards are hoping to find Nolaria first so they can hide her in the barracks. The PCs recognize the captain and the city guards on sight.

Being more familiar with the area, Captain Jordis arrives at the ranch first. While Jordis never liked the Hellbreakers on principle, they know the rebels can hide Nolaria better than the city squad ever could. They give the PCs a chance to talk before attacking, allowing them to attempt two @Check[deception|dc:25] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:25] or @Check[intimidation|dc:25] checks. If the PCs succeed at both, they convince Jordis to leave and act as if they didn't find anyone. If any check is a critical success, Jordis tells the PCs that the Hellknight troops are coming. If the PCs don't succeed at both checks, Jordis apologizes and informs the PCs that the guards have to search the area.

Skirmish at the RanchLow 9

@UUID[Actor.NKsacYTtNA5CoZSP]{Elite City Guard Squadron} @UUID[Actor.Gdqw0nl4Gig4tE49]{Jordis Serelli} @UUID[Actor.btO2arHLLrhf8ZRr]{Chelaxian Knights (2)} @UUID[Actor.NwhF3HEkjSruJsQD]{Hellknight Cavalry Brigades (2)}

Fifteen minutes later, the cavalry brigades arrive and immediately initiate combat. If Jordis is there, their troop joins the scuffle on the side of the Hellknight brigades. Jordis orders a retreat for the city guard after the PCs get two critical hits on them or their troop, or if they're reduced to 40 Hit Points or fewer, whichever comes first.

The Hellknights, meanwhile, are completely willing to raze the ranch to the ground to try and find the fugitive. The Hellknight troops fight until they are routed and their commanders fight until they are reduced to 25 Hit Points or fewer, at which point they flee.

Treasure: @UUID[Actor.2PywLihDh0NuZ3fi]{Nolaria's Gift}
Nolaria gifts the PCs a greater coyote cloak for rescuing her. She also managed to sneak out a book on rituals Ildris gifted her years ago, through which the PCs can learn three rituals: fortifying brew, planar servitor, and resurrect. Learning a ritual takes 8 hours, and a PC can only learn 1 ritual per day.

Reward: For driving off the Hellknights, award the PCs 70 XP and 5 Reputation Points as word spreads that some heroes—the sources won't say who, so everyone assumes it must be the Hellbreakers—saved the ranch from “bandits.” This is the last encounter that rewards Reputation Points in the adventure.

Development: If the PCs fail this encounter, the ranch is burned down in what is remembered later as the Firstbloom Sacking, and they lose access to the ranch. The Vulaunex family laments how things turn out but say they can always rebuild. The land is still there, as it always will be.

Regardless of the outcome, Ethran advises the PCs to move into Sarini Manor and bring Nolaria with them. Nolaria informs the Hellbreakers of the current situation within Saringallow and the events that led up to her flight from the city. As Ildris's child and Saringallow's gravekeeper, Nolaria is one of the few people who knows almost every social circle within the city.

Interrupted Celebrations.name: Interrupted Celebrations
Interrupted Celebrations.text:
Interrupted Celebrations

The PCs are due for a rest after taking over Sarini Manor. Ethran and Jenvirik take over the duty of setting up the command post so the party can get some downtime. Since they're now free on the vernal equinox, Fierdo asks if they would like to participate in the local celebration of Firstbloom on the night of the 19th. The PCs can accept or decline as they see fit; this decision only has a small impact on their starting location for the next encounter.

Firstbloom: For those who work in agriculture, Firstbloom is often considered the start of a new year. The holiday is celebrated on the evening before the vernal equinox, which keeps the celebration from overlapping with the numerous tasks required during Planting Week. While the PCs likely missed much of the setup, they are nevertheless welcome to join in the feasting, dancing, and exchanging of flower crowns.

Development: As midnight draws near, Nolaria stumbles into the celebrations, seeking sanctuary. The fact that Nolaria escaped from Saringallow with intel on the city's current state makes her an important asset.

The Battle for Saringallow.name: The Battle for Saringallow
The Battle for Saringallow.text:
Chapter 9: The Battle for Saringallow

Chapter Timeline

Chapter 9 starts in the last third of the month of Pharast before extending into Gozran. Below are the dates of specific events featured in this chapter, as well as proposed deadlines the PCs should follow. GMs are welcome to make adjustments as they see fit.

 

Pharast 4726 ar

  • 20th: Firstbloom celebrations at Vulaunex Ranch are interrupted by a skirmish.
  • 21st: PCs and Hellbreakers relocate to Sarini Manor. Nolaria divulges what happened in the city.
  • 31st: Deadline for recruiting and gathering the Hellbreaker army.

 

Gozran 4726 ar

  • 5th: Battle of Saringallow begins.
  • 7th: Currentseve. Deadline for breaking the siege on Saringallow.
  • 8th: Caeto begins his trip on land toward Saringallow from Logas.
  • 10th: Caeto arrives in Saringallow. The Hellbreakers spring their ambush and confront him.

While the party was infiltrating Sarini Manor, Saringallow underwent a trial of its own. The occupying soldiers forced the city to relinquish their emergency supplies and begin rationing. Prominent holy locations were closed; some were even desecrated to ease Cheliax's bound devils and help summon more. Activities down to daily grocery trips are now monitored, scrutinized, and restricted. Festivities are likewise prohibited, even those that were essential in function to the local agriculture and economy.

On the 19th of Pharast, Captain Jordis Serelli (determined nonbinary aiuvarin guard captain 5), Mayor Sandra Trinelli (savvy female human mayor 6), and Ildris Ruvarra (wise male human cleric of Erastil 6) approached the commander of the forces to implore for leniency in the upcoming Planting Week. Their request was met with indifference, mockery, and violence. The commander left in charge, Caeto, decided to make an example out of the Erastilian, Ildris. The old priest was publicly beaten, dragged through the streets in chains, and then imprisoned to serve as a stern warning to the population.

Ildris's adopted daughter, Nolaria Wintren (adventurous female human cleric of Erastil 5), nearly jumped the procession in what would have been a futile attempt to save the priest. Her friends pulled her away just in time to hide her when the occupying forces declared a citywide warrant to arrest and imprison any non-Asmodean clergy until further notice. Under the cover of night, Nolaria snuck back home to collect her belongings, but she was spotted by a night patrol. With pursuers hot on her heels, Nolaria headed in the direction of Sarini Manor, to the ranch where a small private celebration of Firstbloom was taking place.

Scorchhome Relations.name: Scorchhome Relations
Scorchhome Relations.text:
Scorchhome Relations

As the dust settles, the goblins of the Chitterwood formally name their region Scorchhome and declare it a free and independent nation. There are tensions amongst the goblinoids on whether to trust humanoids and establish a formal alliance or keep to themselves. Brakknap prefers to see all ancestries unite and suggests the PCs destroy the bigoted and violent organization of the Isgeri Slayers as a show of good faith. The PCs can easily track down disparate groups of Isgeri Slayers to stamp out the organization, but the real issue lies in resolving the wounds of the past that have manifested into such a hateful response.
